title: Principal Solutions Architect, Quantum-Safe Networks
description:
Principal Solutions Architect - Quantum-Safe Networks

Location: Remote, US

Department: Engineering & Technology

About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: This position is US-based and can work onsite or hybrid from one of our offices or fully remote.
Travel: Up to 30%, domestic and international
Job ID: 1779

The Role:

We are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to design how networks become quantum-safe — for the largest network operators, enterprises, and government agencies in the world.

Today's networks are secured with cryptography that a cryptographically relevant quantum computer will break. Every operator and enterprise will have to inventory their cryptography, make it agile, migrate to post-quantum algorithms, and in the highest-assurance segments complement that with quantum-safe key distribution. Almost nobody knows yet what that architecture actually looks like. That is the problem you will solve — first with customers, on real networks, and then as reusable architectures that shape what IonQ builds.

This role sits deliberately in two places. About half your time is customer-facing: in collaboration with our GTM colleagues, you’ll be leading architecture discussions, designing quantum-safe target architectures and migration paths, running proofs of concept and interoperability tests, and supporting complex pursuits as the technical authority. The other half is design authority, standards work, and providing thought leadership internally and externally: turning what you learn in the field into reference architectures, migration playbooks, standards, whitepapers, blogs, and product requirements that our engineering and product teams build against.

You are equally comfortable in a firewall design review as you are in a discussion about hybrid key exchange and crypto-agility. You can explain to a CISO why their crypto inventory is the hard part, and to a network engineer exactly which IPsec algorithms to use and where they could insert external key material in order to become quantum-safe.

This is not a software architecture role — you will not own a codebase (it’s a plus if you can do some scripting). It is an architecture and customer role: you own designs, decisions, and the technical credibility of IonQ's quantum-safe networking story.

Responsibilities:

  • Design quantum-safe target architectures and migration paths for customer networks — spanning WAN and transport, data center and campus, segmentation and access control, key management, and the crypto that underpins all of it.
  • Lead technical discovery and architecture workshops with network, security, and infrastructure teams. Assess the current state, identify where cryptography is embedded and where it is brittle, and build a migration plan the customer can actually execute.
  • Own the technical thread in complex pursuits: architecture proposals, RFI/RFP responses, security and compliance questions, competitive positioning, and objection handling — in partnership with Sales.
  • In collaboration with the Sales Engineers, design and run proofs of concept, interoperability tests, and pilots — including PQC and hybrid key exchange in production-representative network environments and, where relevant, QKD-integrated links — together with our engineering teams and customer staff.
  • Translate field learning into reusable reference architectures, migration playbooks, interoperability matrices, and design guides that scale beyond the deals you personally work.
  • Serve as the customer's voice in the product process. Bring architectural constraints, integration gaps, and roadmap requirements to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to be actionable, and hold us to them.
  • Track how the standards and threat landscape actually move and contribute to them — NIST PQC standards and migration guidance, protocol work in the IETF, national and sector-specific mandates and deadlines — and keep our architectures and guidance ahead of it.
  • Partner with Marketing, Corporate Communications, and GTM to build IonQ's technical presence in the networking and security community: talks, papers, blogs, standards bodies, and industry events.
  • Raise the technical bar around you — architecture reviews, mentoring, and the design patterns the rest of the team reuses.

Requirements:

  • 15+ years designing and securing enterprise and/or service provider networks, in a solutions architecture, network architecture, security architecture, or senior customer-facing engineering capacity.
  • Deep (hands-on) knowledge of how networks are built and secured today: routing and switching, IP transport, network segmentation, firewall and access control design, VPN and encryption at the network layer, and Zero Trust principles applied to real infrastructure. Multi-vendor experience (for example, Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Nokia) is expected.
  • Working knowledge of applied cryptography as it appears in networks: TLS, IPsec, MACsec, PKI and certificate lifecycle, key management, and how algorithm and key material choices are made and changed in practice.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in front of customers at multiple levels — leading workshops, running architecture discussions with engineers, and holding a credible conversation with a CISO or SVP of Infrastructure about risk, cost, and sequencing.
  • A serious interest in where this is heading, and enough grounding to be credible on day one: post-quantum cryptography and crypto-agility, quantum key distribution, and the migration challenge facing existing networks. You do not need to have shipped a PQC migration — very few people have — but you should be able to reason about the problem rigorously and be visibly motivated to go deep.
  • Strong written communication. Architectures, migration plans, and design guidance are a large part of the output.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30%, primarily within the US, with incidental international travel.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with post-quantum cryptography migration: cryptographic discovery and inventory, crypto-agility architecture, hybrid key exchange, or PQC deployment in a network or PKI context.
  • Hands-on exposure to quantum key distribution or quantum networking — testbeds, carrier or research trials, key delivery interfaces to encryptors, or optical and transport-layer integration.
  • Experience at a network or security vendor, service provider, hyperscaler, or a large enterprise network or security team — with real accountability for architecture decisions at scale.
  • Familiarity with the security and compliance frameworks customers will map this work to: NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001, FISMA, FedRAMP, or sector-specific regulation.
  • Public-sector, defense, financial services, or telecom experience, where high-assurance and long data-confidentiality horizons make this problem urgent today.
  • Contributions to standards or the technical community: IETF, ETSI, national PQC migration working groups, published writing, or conference talks.
  • Certifications that validate technical depth — CISSP, CCIE/JNCIE, CCNP Security, or equivalent.
  • Comfort with automation and tooling — Python, config-as-code, network telemetry — enough to build a credible demo or analysis yourself rather than waiting on someone else.

title: AI Researcher
description:
Description

Credit and Fraud Risk (CFR) is a global function, responsible for making the right credit and fraud risk decisions that uphold operational excellence, drive growth, and accelerate innovation across American Express. CFR combines technology and infrastructure with new computing techniques to make better risk decisions and provide real-time customer communications and fraud servicing.

AI Labs seeks an AI Researcher to contribute to advanced research that will power credit, fraud and marketing decisions. The candidate serves as a thought leader and a problem-solver who can blend business, technical, and industry best practices when it comes to developing the models, and algorithms that power our customers’ digital experiences. This role sits at the intersection of applied AI research, large-scale AI platforms, and large-scale compute infrastructure. The AI researcher will help define and execute a forward-looking research agenda and help to translate cutting-edge machine learning, and systems innovation into scalable, governed, and business-critical AI capabilities. Role is focused on advanced modelling solutions for structured data (tabular data, sequence of events, timeseries, graph-based structures).

The ideal candidate will combine deep hand-on ML research expertise with strong practical knowledge and experience in building scalable infrastructure and data science platforms.

Colleagues in AI Labs serve as key members of the Global Decision Science organization within Credit and Fraud Risk at American Express. This critical team is responsible for managing enterprise risks throughout the customer lifecycle, across our consumer and commercial businesses, and across all our global products. We develop industry-first data capabilities, build profitable decision-making frameworks, create machine learning-powered predictive models, and improve customer servicing strategies.

Our Global Decision Science teams use industry leading modelling and AI practices to predict customer behaviour. We develop, deploy and validate predictive models and support the use of models in economic logic to enable profitable decisions across credit, fraud, marketing and servicing optimization engines.



Responsibilities
  • Lead research and drive integration into business for advanced AI research in areas such as graph-based methods, reinforcement learning, transformer-based models, tabular doundational models and causal-modelling techniques
  • Lead research, development and implementation of Sequence-based foundational models for event streams, such customer actions and transaction histories.
  • Partner with business users, technology and infrastructure teams to ensure solutions are flexible, secure, cost-effective, and compliant with enterprise standards
  • Translate research outcomes into production-ready platforms, tools, and capabilities that are adopted at scale across the enterprise

  • Work in close partnership with other research teams in AI labs.
  • Actively contribute to highly effective and engaged team culture focused on innovation.


Qualifications

  • Ph.D degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Physics, or a related quantitative field or equivalent work experience.

  • Work experience in applied research lab organisations is a plus.

  • Very strong record of applied research impact through platforms, patents, production systems, or enterprise-scale adoption, in addition to traditional publications.

  • Expertise with GPU-accelerated ML workloads, high-performance computing, and advanced optimization techniques are essential.

  • Exceptional programming skills in Python, Spark. Additional knowledge of C/C++ and Java is preferred

  • Expertise in hybrid-cloud AI/ML infrastructure, including Google Cloud (e.g., Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataproc) and large-scale distributed computing environments.

  • Strong knowledge of databases and related languages/tools such as SQL, NoSQL, Hive, etc.

  • Exceptional people leadership and managerial skills

  • Ability to work in a dynamic, cross-functional environment, with a strong attention to detail

  • Effective communication skills and ability to explain complex data products in simple terms

  • Strong relationship building and collaborative skills.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Intelligent Messaging, AI Journeys
description:
Senior Software Engineer, Intelligent Messaging, AI Journeys

Location: San Francisco, CA

Department: Engineering

Attentive® is the AI marketing platform for 1:1 personalization redefining the way brands and people connect. We’re the only marketing platform that combines powerful technology with human expertise to build authentic customer relationships. By unifying SMS, RCS, email, and push notifications, our AI-powered personalization engine delivers bespoke experiences that drive performance, revenue, and loyalty through real-time behavioral insights.
Recognized as the #1 provider in SMS Marketing by G2, Attentive partners with more than 8,000 customers across 70+ industries. Leading global brands like Crate and Barrel, Urban Outfitters, and Carter’s work with us to enable billions of interactions that power tens of billions in revenue for our customers.
With a distributed global workforce and employee hubs in New York City, San Francisco, London, and Sydney, Attentive’s team has been consistently recognized for its performance and culture. We’re proud to be included in Deloitte’s Fast 500 (four years running!), LinkedIn’s Top Startups, Forbes’ Cloud 100 (five years running!), Inc.’s Best Workplaces, and the Human Rights Campaign Foundation's Corporate Equality Index!

About the Role

Our Engineering team creates innovative product experiences that power personalized marketing at massive scale. We develop cutting-edge applications and systems that process 100s of billions of messages and events per year, enabling marketers to connect effectively with hundreds of millions of consumers. Joining our team offers a high-growth career opportunity to work with some of the world’s most talented engineers in a high-performance and high-impact culture.

As a Senior Software Engineer in our Intelligent Messaging, you will pioneer the future of personalized 1:1 marketing by architecting robust, scalable backend systems powered by advanced AI and LLMs, including cutting-edge Generative AI and GPT technologies. Collaborating with top-tier engineers, data scientists, product managers, and designers, you’ll craft the foundation and reshape the platform of multi-channel messaging experimentation to support innovative, AI-driven applications that empower marketers to forge deep, meaningful connections with consumers at scale. Your impactful work will drive the delivery of billions of tailored messages, transforming consumer shopping experiences and fueling success for the world’s leading brands.

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for our customer-facing products, ensuring high performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build applications that support multi-channel communications for marketers.
  • Implement and optimize systems that process and deliver billions of messages daily.
  • Improve code quality through code reviews, testing, and advocating for best practices.
  • Identify and address technical debt to ensure the long-term health of our codebase.
  • Drive architectural design and technical decisions, and stay current with emerging technologies to enhance our products.

Your Expertise

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software development focusing on backend systems.
  • Proficiency in Java, Python, or Go, with a strong understanding of object-oriented programming.
  • Experience building and maintaining scalable, high-performance applications.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Solid understanding of software development best practices, including code reviews, writing tests, and continuous integration.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with service-oriented architecture and distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with AWS services and cloud infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of databases such as DynamoDB, Postgres, or Redis.
  • Experience with messaging systems or streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Pulsar).
  • Familiarity with frontend development with React and TypeScript.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.

What We Use

  • Our infrastructure runs primarily in Kubernetes hosted in AWS’s EKS.
  • Infrastructure tooling includes Istio, Datadog,Terraform, CloudFlare, and Helm.
  • Our backend is Java / Spring Boot microservices, built with Gradle, coupled with things like DynamoDB, Kinesis, AirFlow, Postgres, Planetscale, and Redis, hosted via AWS.
  • Our frontend is built with React and TypeScript, and uses best practices like GraphQL, Storybook, Radix UI, Vite, esbuild, and PlaywrightOur automation is driven by custom and open source machine learning models, lots of data and built with Python, Metaflow, HuggingFace 🤗, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Pandas.

You'll get competitive perks and benefits, from health & wellness to equity, to help you bring your best self to work.

For US based applicants:

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

The Senior Business Analyst plays a key role in shaping the growth and success of Moniepoint’s payment products. You'll design, test, and implement strategies that improve user acquisition, boost retention, and elevate product engagement. This role blends deep quantitative analysis with collaborative, strategic thinking.   • Build, maintain, and scale self-service dashboards and custom visualisation tools.

title: Agent Experience Engineer
description:
AgentMail is building the identity layer for AI agents, starting with email. Our most important user is an agent: it discovers us through model answers and docs, then signs up and integrates on its own. We're looking for an Agent Experience Engineer to own how AI models and agents discover and use AgentMail. That means AEO, evals, benchmarks, agent traces, docs, and llms.txt.

AgentMail has raised $6M from investors including General Catalyst, Y Combinator, Paul Graham (founder of YC), Karim Atiyeh (founder of Ramp), Paul Copplestone (founder of Supabase), and Dharmesh Shah (founder of HubSpot).

You'll work on:

  • Answer-engine presence: when someone asks an LLM about email or identity for agents, AgentMail is the recommendation. You measure share of voice on the prompts that matter and move it

  • Original research: evals and benchmarks on how well frontier models, open source models, and agent harnesses use AgentMail

  • Agent traces: running agents against our docs and site, reading their reasoning, and fixing what confuses them. A stray Reddit thread once convinced LLMs we have a feature that doesn't exist

  • The agent-facing surface: llms.txt, MCP descriptions, docs structure, and the error messages agents hit at 3am with no human watching

  • The AEO content engine: steering and verifying our automated page pipeline, briefing freelancers, and doing backlink outreach to the pages models already cite

  • The weekly AEO briefing's action queue, from freshness debt to competitor watch

You're a fit if:

  • You build with agents daily and have opinions about what makes a product easy or miserable for an agent to use

  • You work cross functionally by default

  • You express your opinion early, and you'll publish an honest writeup even when the result is inconvenient

  • You go deep on messy technical problems. You'd rather spend a day reading agent traces than guess

  • You understand retrieval: models pull chunks, not pages, and you write accordingly

Strong preference for published technical writing or benchmarks people actually cited. SEO or AEO experience helps, as do contributions to docs or MCP servers in the wild.

Compensation: $110K to $175K, plus 0.2% to 0.5% equity.

title: Product Manager
description:
We are open to candidates in Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane.

At The Instillery, we’re on a mission to build something genuinely different from the standard MSP mold. We’re a fast-moving, high energy group of technical experts across Aotearoa and Australia who love solving hard problems for our customers. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll bring product discipline to a services environment. You’ll work alongside our engineering, sales, and ops teams to take raw service capability and turn it into clear, repeatable, and scalable offerings that customers actually need.

You’ll look at everything we build through three basic lenses:

  1. Desirability: Spending real time with customers to get to the root of their pain points (not just taking feature requests at face value).
  2. Viability: Getting the commercial model right – pricing, gross margin, cutting waste, and proving the ROI.
  3. Feasibility: Making sure our services teams can deliver it consistently at scale, knowing where to automate, and writing practical SOPs (while knowing when a human needs to take over).

What you’ll be doing day to day:

  • Co-creating vendor agnostic, outcome focused offerings using Lean and Design Thinking approaches.
  • Leading front-line conversations, running pilots, and gathering real evidence before we invest in building.
  • Partnering with technical teams to build clear SOPs, proof-of-value reporting, and embedding AI and automation from day one.
  • Running cost models in spreadsheets, managing the product backlog, and keeping the Senior Leadership Team aligned on priorities.
  • Creating the collateral, contracts, and knowledge base content so Sales, Marketing, and Operations are setup for success.

Who You Are

You might already be a Product Manager, or you might be a senior technical consultant, Ops leader, or delivery specialist who’s spent years fixing the gap between what was sold and what could actually be delivered, and now you want to solve that problem at the design stage.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years in tech services (MSP, ITSP, telco, or similar) with a solid understanding of how services are priced, sold, and delivered.
  • You’re comfortable leading conversations, presenting ideas, and digging into actual customer problems.
  • You know your way around vendor ecosystems (Microsoft, Zscaler, Wiz, etc.), understand framework basics (ITIL, Essential Eight, NIST), and can model margins in Excel.
  • You prefer testing and iterating over long slide decks. You ask “why?”, give feedback directly, and adapt quickly when plans change.

Ready to join us?

If you want to help shape the future of our trans-Tasman portfolio, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Machine Learning Engineer

Department: Engineering

Location: Paris

Compensation: €95,680 – €105,752 • 0.006% – 0.011%

Employment Type: FullTime

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

  • Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

  • Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

🤖 About the Machine Learning Team

Join our Machine Learning team, where we’re transforming the ecommerce landscape by automating interactions between merchants and shoppers. Our mission is to make these experiences effortless for everyone involved.

Our team includes Software Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Product Managers, and Designers who work together to advance AI-driven customer support. Our main focus is building an AI Agent that can accurately and efficiently respond to customer inquiries and drive sales!

As a company:

  • We serve 15K+ e-commerce businesses.

  • We handle 1M+ merchant-shopper interactions per day.

  • We recently raised a $30 million Series C (Crunchbase article).

The machine learning solutions we have built are already embedded in the product:

  • A state-of-the-art agentic LLM pipeline that crafts answers and executes e-commerce actions, bringing value to both Gorgias and our customers at scale.

    • Relies on multiple providers, including in-house fine-tuned models.

    • Uses A/B testing to validate prompt engineering.

    • Includes a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system that contextualizes customer requests using ANN, rerankers, feedback loops, and knowledge graphs.

  • Classical NLP classification algorithms that identify non-support-related emails, detect intent, and infer customer sentiment.

  • Clustering based on minimum-cost flow problems to discover new knowledge resources from non-automated interactions.

  • A product recommendation system that drives sales and conversions on merchant websites.

What you'll do

As part of the Machine Learning team, you will play a crucial role in developing, refining, and scaling our AI Agent, which automatically addresses and resolves shopper requests for our merchants. You will optimize and implement solutions that enhance the efficiency, accuracy, and functionality of our AI-driven customer support and marketing solutions.

  • Machine learning:

    • Own feedback loops, observability, and continuous training for deployed systems and models (Hugging Face, Vertex AI, multiple LLM providers)

    • Work on agentic LLM systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and NLP classifiers.

    • Solve product-facing problems using classical NLP and/or LLMs.

    • Keep up with the latest advances in mathematics and computer science.

    • Maintain the ML team's data pipeline (BigQuery, dbt)

  • Engineering:

    • Write clear technical specifications and implement scalable solutions using domain-driven design, enabling fast, reliable, and safe iterations.

    • Maintain our existing services.

    • Own the development lifecycle.

    • Collaborate in a cross-functional team to provide machine learning as a service within Gorgias.

    • Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, and product managers to understand requirements and incorporate feedback.

    • Analyze post-release performance and identify improvements for next iterations.

Who you are

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience and a proven track record in machine learning and software development, with hands-on experience building and operating LLM applications, RAG systems, agentic workflows, and NLP classifiers.

  • Technical skills: Proficiency in Python, modern machine learning and software engineering tools and frameworks. Familiarity with GCP is a plus.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Education: Master's degree in a STEM field (science, technology, engineering, or mathematics) or a related field.

Perks and Benefits

  • 💰Competitive salary & equity (90th percentile worldwide, go check our public salary calculator)

  • 🏖️ 5-week vacation plus 2 weeks RTT (We follow each country's appropriate PTO Laws)

  • 🤕 Paid sick leave

  • 🧸 Paid parental leave (16 weeks)

  • 💻 MacBook Pro

  • 🍽️ Personal credit card to buy lunches (we use Swile)

  • 🏥 We provide private health insurance (we use GAN)

  • 💆🏻‍♀️ Get up to €700 to set up your workstation at home (working from home should feel breezy)

  • 📚 Get up to €2000 of learning material and wellness support per year! This includes €1500 for learning material (such as books, courses, and individual coaching sessions) directly linked to your job scope, as well as a €500 wellness budget. Take advantage of these resources to grow in your role and prioritize your personal development and wellness.

  • 🥰 Every quarter, we organize an online company-wide summit to discuss where we’re going and strengthen social bonds. Once per year we organize offsite team retreats and company retreats!

AI at Gorgias
At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

title: Commercial Associate
description:
In just over a year, we've gone from 0 to over 700 customers with very little marketing spend, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We're now looking for someone exceptional to come and work at the heart of our commercial engine — building deep relationships with our incredible customers, unlocking a huge amount of untapped value in our existing base, and directly shaping how we grow over the next 18 months.

If you're commercially-minded, able to quickly grasp technical concepts, and want to make a massive impact on both the UK's net zero ambitions and the lives (and businesses) of heat pump installers, please read on!

Quick background on Spruce

Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes — there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (). But there's a problem: the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it really hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job, doubling their sales conversion rates, and boosting their bottom line.

Having raised a substantial Seed round last year and with strong customer demand, we're scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We're now starting to expand beyond heat pumps and ultimately want to build an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain.

The Role

You'll be working closely with Esme, Jamie, Rob, Ashley, and Hector at the centre of our commercial operation. You'll have direct relationships with hundreds of installation businesses across the UK, and your work will have an immediate, measurable impact on both our growth and their success. There'll be a ton of variety, but the core areas will be:

  • Drive expansion & commercial growth — you'll unlock a huge amount of value in our existing customer base by increasing product usage, growing accounts, and helping installers see what's possible. A big chunk of our revenue growth will come directly from your work.

  • Become our customers' most trusted partner — you'll build close relationships with our installers, becoming the person they turn to when they want to grow their business. You'll be the first to hear when something's not working and the first to spot an opportunity to help them do more.

  • Create a world-class onboarding experience — you'll own the initial experience for new installers we sign up, making sure their whole team quickly gets to grips with Spruce and feels the impact right away.

  • Be the voice of the customer internally — you'll be the primary source of feedback and insight for Product decision making, directly shaping the improvements and features we build. Your understanding of what installers need and value will drive our roadmap.

  • Build the systems & playbooks that scale us — you'll continuously be trying to automate yourself by improving our self-serve guides and FAQs, developing and managing LLM agents, creating training content, building more effective onboarding processes, and working with our devs and designers to bring tips and tutorials onto the platform.

You'll own revenue targets, be rewarded based on the growth and retention of your accounts, and you'll have a direct influence on company strategy. The reason our customers love us is because we genuinely care about their success, and that starts with you.

Requirements

You'll have at least 2 years work experience and you'll ideally be:

  • Relentlessly proactive — you naturally take responsibility, are always pushing to make things better, and just want to crack on and get stuff done.

  • A natural "people person" — you love working with people, find it easy to warm to them and quickly put them at ease.

  • A brilliant communicator — you write compelling, concise copy and can explain complex concepts simply.

  • Deeply curious — you're interested in the world and people around you, want to understand how and why things work the way they do, and you love getting stuck into the detail.

… and you'll hopefully also love heat pumps!

Benefits

  • Base salary £40–60k, plus 20% on-target bonus (£50k–£72k OTE)

  • Slice of equity (options) in the company

  • ️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

  • Hybrid working: Min. 3 days in-person a week (London or Bristol)

  • Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

  • Private Medical Cover

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • ‍‍‍ Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

  • Meaningful, impactful work that genuinely improves the world.

Working at Spruce

  • We're currently a close-knit team split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-4 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight.

  • You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions.

  • We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what can we learn and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.

  • Feedback is constant, direct, and kind — we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.

title: WHSEQ and Compliance Advisor (Sydney or Brisbane)

Ensure a program addressing climate change, biodiversity, carbon emissions, waste management and improved resource efficiency is implemented in reducing the company’s carbon footprint, together with improvements for social impact, diversity and inclusivity.

To be successful in this role, you will need:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a HSE role within an environmental and/or construction environment

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerBI and Sharepoint

Our presence in the Australian market will further enhance the aim of expanding on our consultancy services in both the Australian market and wider Asia Pacific region as part of the next stage of our Global growth journey.

title: Senior Integration Engineer
description:
Sr Integration Engineer

Location: 6380 Rogerdale Rd, Houston, TX, United States, 77072

Department: CORP_56553B

Work Location: onsite

At Tailored Brands, we help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments. Our Technology team loves the way they feel and thrive at work, with:
• Flexible work opportunities, including remote and hybrid options
• Small, empowered teams that have fun delivering real value for our customers
• A culture that values a 50-year legacy while eagerly embracing the future

Want to be part of this? We currently have an exciting opportunity for Integration Engineer to join our Tailored Technology team. This role is suited for a professional who excels at solving complex integration challenges, working with modern technologies, and building scalable enterprise connectivity solutions. The ideal candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and optimize integrations that support Tailored Brands’ strategic business objectives, while continuously driving innovation and efficiency across systems.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities
• Analyze, design, and implement integration solutions for both on-premises and cloud-based systems.
• Contribute to the design and development of secure, scalable integration solutions, following established architecture standards and best practices.
• Integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring compatibility and reliable data flow between on-premises and cloud platforms.
• Develop and maintain integration pipelines, with a focus on Google Cloud Dataflow, to support business and data use cases.
• Create and maintain documentation for data flows, integration points, and configurations to support ongoing operations and knowledge sharing.
• Monitor integration pipelines, identify performance issues, and troubleshooting failures to ensure system reliability.
• Work with project stakeholders to support delivery timelines, manage assigned tasks, and communicate progress and risks.
• Investigate and resolve technical issues, applying sound problem-solving skills and escalating when appropriate.
• Collaborate with team members and contribute to integration and data initiatives as an active team participant.
• Partner with cross-functional teams, including data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders, to understand requirements and deliver effective integration solutions.


What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience
• 5+ years of experience developing and supporting enterprise integration solutions.
• Hands-on experience with cloud integration technologies such as Google Cloud Dataflow, Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler/Composer, GCP Application Integration, and Apigee, along with development using Java and frameworks like Apache Beam and Maven.
• Working knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• Experience with XML and JSON technologies, including XSLT, XPath, and XSD, and familiarity with enterprise integration platforms such as the TIBCO suite.
• Exposure to messaging systems such as IBM MQ and API gateway technologies.
• Experience developing and consuming SOAP and RESTful web services, with the ability to troubleshoot and debug integration issues.
• Understanding of SOA principles and API design best practices, with experience contributing to REST API implementations.
• Familiarity with relational databases such as Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, DB2, or SQL Server, as well as Google Cloud databases like Cloud SQL, and BigQuery, with the ability to write and optimize SQL queries.
• Experience using testing and debugging tools such as SoapUI, Postman, JMeter, and unit testing frameworks like JUnit.
• Proficiency with version control systems such as Git for collaborative development.
• Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams including QA, business analysts, and project managers.
• Ability to work independently on assigned tasks, with a strong problem-solving mindset and willingness to seek guidance when needed.
• Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies, especially within cloud and integration ecosystems.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

If you see yourself in this role, but fall short in any areas above, apply anyway! We love to invest in our team members!

The Best Kept Secret in Retail

Tailored Brands is North America’s leading specialty retailer of menswear, famous for world-class customer service and unique offerings like tailoring and custom suits. We are best known by our brands, including Men’s Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, K&G Fashion Superstore, and Moores Clothing for Men in Canada.

We are emerging from the pandemic with incredible momentum. We own a unique and special market segment experiencing record-level demand. This has inspired our 3-year journey to become Legendary; an exciting strategy that leans heavily upon a strong technology foundation.

With over 1,000 stores across the US and Canada, 15,000 employees, and over 35 million customers, we’re the perfect size! Large enough to demand leading-edge enterprise-worthy technology, but small enough to move quickly and empower our teams with significant scope & autonomy.

Apply now to power your career journey to Legendary!
Benefits
This role is eligible for healthcare including medical, dental and vision, retirement savings (401k with a company match), income protection programs such as life, accident and disability insurance, paid time off for sick leave, vacation, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays, wellbeing program, commuter, adoption assistance, education assistance, legal services, and employee merchandise discounts. For more detailed information go Tailoredbrands.com/working-here/people-culture.



Work-Life Balance
We understand the demands of work, school, family, and personal responsibilities. Through our work-life resources and programs we offer services for every stage of life to help you manage the day-to-day needs. We offer programs such as:

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Data to build and lead the technical foundation that powers Boulevard's data ecosystem and products. This role is responsible for our data infrastructure, data governance, ML capabilities and the underlying systems that enable data-driven products and decision-making across the company.

Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll play a critical leadership role in establishing Boulevard's data platform as a strategic competitive advantage. Your work will shape how data is collected, processed, and leveraged across the company - driving insights, powering product innovation, and ensuring operational excellence. You will ensure that data is reliable, secure, performant, and accessible to support our growing customer base and internal teams. You'll lead a high-impact team of data engineers, with a mandate to grow and scale the organization. This is a foundational role where you'll architect and build systems that will support Boulevard's growth for years to come.

Domains of Ownership
  • Data Infrastructure & Platform Engineering - Build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines and infrastructure
  • Data Products - Partner with the insights team, product management and product engineering to power reporting dashboards, analytics features, and data-driven customer experiences
  • Data Governance & Quality - Establish frameworks for data integrity, lineage, and compliance
  • Data Security & Privacy - Ensure data protection, access controls, and regulatory compliance (including HIPAA)
  • ML/AI Platform Operations - Provide the foundation and standards for machine learning and AI capabilities
  • Real-time & Batch Processing - Design and optimize data processing systems for various use cases
  • Data Integration & APIs - Enable seamless data flow between systems and external partners

Key Projects & Initiatives

  • Modern Data Infrastructure: Continue building out scalable data infrastructure using tools like dbt, Airflow, and real-time streaming platforms
  • Customer Data Products: Collaborate with Product Management and Product Engineering to deliver customer-facing reporting, dashboards, and analytics features
  • Data Platform for Insights: Build robust data pipelines that enable the Data Insights team to deliver external benchmarking and internal business intelligence
  • Data Governance Framework: Establish comprehensive data quality monitoring, lineage tracking, and governance policies
  • Platform Self-Service: Build tools and frameworks that enable other teams to safely and efficiently work with data
  • Security & Compliance: Strengthen data protection, access controls, and ensure HIPAA compliance across all data systems
  • Performance Optimization: Continuously improve cost, speed, and reliability of data processing systems
  • ML/AI Infrastructure: Provide robust foundation for training, deployment, and monitoring of machine learning models and LLMs

What You'll Do Here

  • Technical Leadership: Define and execute the long-term technical strategy for Boulevard's data platform, ensuring scalability and reliability as we grow
  • Team Building: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data platform engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of excellence
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Product Engineering, and the Data Insights team to understand requirements and deliver platform capabilities that enable customer-facing data products and internal insights
  • Architecture & Design: Drive architectural decisions for data systems, balancing current needs with future flexibility and scalability
  • Operational Excellence: Establish monitoring, alerting, and operational practices that ensure high availability and performance of data systems
  • Standards & Governance: Define and implement data governance policies, security standards, and quality frameworks across the organization
  • Strategic Planning: Work with leadership to align data platform roadmap with business objectives and technical strategy

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • 10+ years of experience in data platform engineering, distributed systems, or infrastructure engineering, with deep expertise in building scalable data processing systems
  • 5+ years of people management experience, including managing senior engineers and technical leads
  • Proven track record of building data platforms and ML systems that support both internal analytics and customer-facing data products
  • Experience delivering customer-facing reporting, dashboards, and analytics features in collaboration with Product teams
  • Strong experience with modern data stack technologies (dbt, Airflow, Snowflake, Kafka, etc.)
  • Deep understanding of data governance, quality frameworks, and security best practices
  • A strategic mindset with the ability to translate business goals into technical roadmaps, balancing short-term execution with long-term vision.

How We'll Take Care of You

In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
What Makes Cloudbeds Unique
At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started.

Location: Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
  • Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
  • Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
  • Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
  • Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction
  • Remain hands-on in the codebase through implementation, technical spikes, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and the most consequential or ambiguous engineering work
  • Raise the technical effectiveness of the wider organization through mentoring, architecture guidance, engineering standards, documentation, and constructive challenge

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
  • Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
  • Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
  • Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
  • Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
  • Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
  • A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
  • A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
  • Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
  • Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

  • Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us
Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. title: Business Analyst - 12 month FTC
description:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

Does this sound like you?

You're a mid-level Business Analyst with hands on experience in requirements gathering, process mapping, and stakeholder management. You're curious, confident, and not afraid to ask the awkward questions, because you know that's usually where the most valuable work begins. You have a solid grounding in change management and risk governance, and you know how to deliver in environments where both matter. You thrive in fast moving, collaborative environments and are energised by the prospect of joining a fintech scale up where your analysis directly shapes how the business grows and changes.

This is a 12 month fixed term contract.

What you’ll do:

As a Business Analyst at Flagstone, you'll sit within the Transformation & Change team and play a central role in delivering meaningful change across the business. Day to day, that looks like:

  • Conducting high quality business analysis to accelerate and unblock strategic change initiatives

  • Gathering and documenting requirements to make sure the end result always meets real user and business needs

  • Designing and mapping processes, turning complexity into something simple and scalable

  • Facilitating workshops and stakeholder sessions to drive decisions and keep things moving

  • Supporting change readiness, including training and risk mitigation planning

  • Making sure changes land in line with Risk & Compliance policies

  • Working closely with Product and Engineering to deliver joined up outcomes

What you’ll bring:

  • Hands on experience across requirements gathering, process design, and stakeholder management

  • Comfortable working across the full change delivery lifecycle, from initial analysis through to delivery and change readiness

  • Experience of working in Agile environments, you know how to work iteratively and adapt quickly

  • Process design and requirements analysis skills

  • A self starter mentality, being comfortable planning and managing your own workload, ensuring the right analysis is delivered at the right time

  • Prioritisation skills, where you're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and demands, and you know how to identify what needs your attention first

  • Professional courage to question a brief, pushing back when something doesn't stack up, and saying no when the work isn't high value. You do all of this without creating friction

  • Exceptional stakeholder management and facilitation skills, including with senior and cross functional audiences

  • Clear communication, both written and verbal

  • A relevant certification is a plus (e.g. BCS BA Diploma, Six Sigma, IIBA, APM)

Backgrounds we're interested in

We'd love to hear from people who have worked in a similar sized organisation and are comfortable working with ambiguity and fast pace of change delivery. Experience in fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry would be an advantage and you'll be comfortable operating in an environment where risk and compliance aren't an afterthought.

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - spend at least 1 day a week with your team in our collaborative London office

  • Mental wellbeing support - access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Private health care - enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - to help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

All are welcome.

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

description:
In order to be considered for this role, after clicking "Apply Now" above and being redirected, you must fully complete the application process on the follow-up screen.

OVERVIEW »

Contract: Freelance/Casual

Location: Newcastle Red Bulls - Kingston Park Stadium, Brunton Road, Kenton Bank Foot, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE13 8AF

Working Hours: Match-days only. The working day starts around 5 hours pre-kick-off and ends around one hour after the match (Approximately 8 hours per match-day)

Salary: £14 per hour (includes holiday entitlement)

Start Date: ASAP

The Role

Hawk-Eye provides medical video replay services at all Rugby fixtures across England. We are looking for a reliable and tech-savvy individual to join our team in Newcastle, to support our on-site operations at Newcastle Red Bulls’ home matches alongside another Hawk-Eye Match Day Technician.

This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of sports technology across major sporting events. You will be part of a dynamic team delivering world-class tech solutions, designed to make rugby safer, fairer and more engaging.

All fixtures take place on Friday evenings, Saturdays and Sundays, with the season running from September through to June. We will require you to be regularly available for Sale Sharks’ home fixtures during these periods.

We provide services across a wide number of local and global Rugby events, including domestic UK & European club competitions, international fixtures and major World Rugby events. As part of our wider rugby team, you may have the opportunity to work at these events.

Key Responsibilities

  • Installation and setup of Hawk-Eye technology on Match Day, alongside a second Hawk-Eye Match Day Technician

  • Operation of Hawk-Eye medical video replay technology, supporting the Match Day Doctor and other medical staff in identifying and reviewing potential head injury incidents

  • Accurate logging and post-match clipping of medical events identified by matchday medical personnel

  • Liaise with our Rugby Remote Support team to ensure smooth setup and match operations

  • Conduct detailed pre-match checks of the system in accordance with standard procedures

  • Coordinate with on-site host broadcasters to integrate with our Hawk-Eye services

  • Monitoring hardware and software performance

  • Troubleshoot hardware and software issues alongside our Remote Support team using your technical knowledge and problem-solving skills

  • Taking full responsibility for our system on-site, representing Hawk-Eye with professionalism and confidence

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Technical background, comfortable with computer hardware and software

  • Ideally with or studying for a university degree in science, technology, engineering or relevant equivalent experience

  • Bright and enterprising with excellent organisational, analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Proactive, responsible attitude with the ability to work on your initiative

  • Strong team player with the ability to cooperate effectively alongside another on-site Hawk-Eye team member

  • Time management skills and the ability to work in a high-pressure, procedural, live broadcast environment

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with clients and stakeholders

  • An interest in rugby and/or rugby analysis

  • Able to adapt to flexible working conditions with irregular working days, including weekends and longer days

At Hawk-Eye Innovations, we appreciate and value the importance of potential and growth. If you believe that you excel in certain areas and possess the passion and desire to develop further, we encourage you to apply.

Team Culture

We pride ourselves on our team culture. We believe in fostering a supportive environment where every team member can contribute their best work. Our core values include:

  • Innovation: We constantly seek new ways to improve and innovate in the sports entertainment industry.

  • Teamwork: We celebrate our successes and learn from our experiences as a team.

  • Passion: Our love for sports drives everything we do.

Ready to kickstart your career in sports technology? Apply now and become a part of our Hawk-Eye team!

title: Process Integration Engineer
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Jireh is looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer to join their team as a Process Integration Engineer. As a Process Integration Engineer, you will work in a dynamic team environment at AOS Semiconductor's leading technology fabrication facility (Jireh Semiconductor) located in Hillsboro, Oregon. This focus of this position is to work with device/process module/product engineering group to develop silicon power device process technology and improve existing technology yield. Primary responsibilities are to process flow implementation, electrical characterization (failure analysis), and wafer level testing yield monitoring. We prefer to find a staff level candidate, but will also consider senior level candidates.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Focus on Power Device (MOSFET/TVS etc.) technologies development in Jireh Semiconductor
    Development:
  • Perform process simulation, Create technology process flows with process specifications
  • Work with process module team to define test structures for process integration and process module development.
  • Design statistical experiments and analyze results to optimize device architecture and/or process modules. Perform device characterization and report on the results
  • Collaborate with design groups within the company to troubleshoot device related problem, provide documentation and expertise to maximize the efficient use of process technologies
  • Develop devices that ensure the highest level of reliability for products. Work with the Product Engineering and Reliability group to test, characterize and evaluate device and process
  • New Product Introduction
  • Collaborate with product engineering team to perform NPI (New Product Introduction) on existing platform (analysis DOE/Pre-Production lots data/documentation according NPI procedure to release new product)
  • Yield monitor/improvement
  • response to newly released platform safe launch stage yield monitor/improvement actions
  • low yield root cause identification (through failure analysis, inline data analysis and lot history)
  • provide solution for low yield through process condition splits design

REQUIRED EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering degree
  • 3+ years of experience in a development role ( power device development is preferred)
  • Working knowledge in semiconductor process technology and wafer fabrication

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

The ideal candidate will have knowledge of semiconductor device physics and experience with device processing and integration, test structure definition, design rule generation, DOE, failure analysis, process control document (PCD) generation, and device characterization. Experience with discrete power devices is preferred

*Pay range listed in this job posting is an estimate only, and is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of pay for any specific employee future or past. Offers made are always dependent upon actual experience, education and other factors. Depending upon experience, candidates may receive an offer for a position level lower or higher than that listed, i.e. application to a Staff level position does not guarantee an offer of Staff title.

COMPANY INFORMATION:

Alpha and Omega Semiconductor (AOS) is committed to excellence in design, manufacturing, and responsiveness to our customers through the continued development of new technologies, products and innovative solutions. description:
Lead Solutions Architect - DERMS

Location: Remote

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Job Description Summary

We are looking for a Lead Solutions Architect – DERMS, who will join our Pre-Sales team, which is a client-centric, driven and results-oriented group focusing on enabling sales with strong understanding of the utility business perspective and driving the strategic growth by delivering exceptional end-to-end business and technical solutions to GridOS DERMS customers and partners.

Lead Solutions Architect – DERMS, works truly in a cross-functional capacity: working closely with our partners, US and Canada Account Managers, Commercial Operations team, Marketing and Communications team, and Product Management team.

Job Description

Who are you?

As the Lead Solution Architect on DERMS, you understand the utility challenges and opportunities at an operational and a regulatory level with the flexibility to undertake technical and functional analysis while focusing on client management and quality of services.

You can empathize with customers, convey the strategic value of deploying GridOS DERMS enterprise level software solutions and construct a powerful technical solution to meet customers’ needs. You provide timely feedback to Account Managers and Product Managers on client’s requirements.

What will our new Lead Solutions Architect on DERMS work on?

Pre-sales Engagements

  • Identify and qualify new leads / opportunities and actively nurture relationships with existing and prospective client accounts

  • Consult with customers and provide technical expertise and recommendations based on the required applications (e.g. provide GridOS DERMS product-line overview, conducting product demonstrations etc.)

  • Understand and document the technical/process/policy/regulatory-related challenges customers face and identify appropriate and suitable use cases and GridOS DERMS Solution offerings addressing their challenges directly

  • Articulate new customer requirements, existing trends, and issues to the Product Management team for analysis (e.g. user stories, capabilities, functional/non-functional requirements, roadmap etc.)

  • Definition and assessment of value-added technology-enabled services leveraging GridOS DERMS Platform

Product Demonstrations/Proposals

  • Work with Account Managers to meet customer needs and deliver proposals on time

  • Work with Proposal Manager for RFP/RFQ/Government Programs by providing technical input

  • Identify any proposal-related Product Development scope outside of the current roadmap and flag with Product Management team for analysis

  • Work with Marketing Manager on marketing material by contributing with information towards the technical aspects of customer-facing marketing campaigns by monitoring competitive products, identifying use cases and channeling market response and feedback

  • Support marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events

  • Develop and maintain a library of continuously updated “customer-ready” presentations at multiple technical levels for use during pre-sales engagements

  • Internal knowledge transfer and communication of technical insights from the customer

  • Provide feedback to US, Canada and International Account Managers, Product Management and Research and Development teams regarding customer feedback, product bugs and quality defects

Requirements

Here’s what you bring:

  • The education. You hold a Bachelors or Masters degree in engineering or a related field with a focus on Power Systems.

  • The experience. You have minimum 5+ years of strong utility industry knowledge with combination of technical sales and technical writing experience in the energy market.

  • The work arrangement. Remote role based in the US, up to 25% travel required based on the business needs.

  • The knowledge. You are highly familiar with emerging energy industry trends, regulations and implications on utility customers in the area of DER management, microgrids, distribution planning, SCADA and asset management. In addition, knowledge of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), interconnection and interoperability standards such as IEEE 1547, and industry communication protocols including IEEE 2030.5 (SEP2), OpenADR, and related utility-to-DER integration technologies is highly desirable. Familiarity with DER aggregation, virtual power plants (VPPs), demand response programs, inverter-based resources, and DER integration use cases is considered a strong asset.

  • The excellence. You get things done on-time and within the project deadlines.

  • The teamwork. You are self-motivated collaborator that can also work as a successful independent researcher.

  • The communication. You have exceptional written and oral communication skills, can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences and provide high-level summaries of the solution to the C-suite.
