Planned Parenthood organizations serve all people with care and compassion, with respect, and without judgment, striving to create equitable access to health care. Through health centers, programs in schools and communities, and online resources, Planned Parenthood is a trusted source of reliable education and information that allows people to make informed health decisions. We do all this because we care passionately about helping people lead healthier lives.

Planned Parenthood Federation of America (PPFA) is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization that supports the independently incorporated Planned Parenthood affiliates, which operate non-profit health centers
across the U.S. PPFA also works to educate the public on and advocate for issues of sexual and reproductive health. Formed as the advocacy arm of Planned Parenthood Federation of America, Planned Parenthood Action Fund is a separate non-profit membership organization tax-exempt under section 501(c)(4). The Action Fund engages in educational, advocacy, and limited electoral activity, including grassroots organizing, legislative advocacy, and voter education in furtherance of the Planned Parenthood mission.

Planned Parenthood Federation of America and Planned Parenthood Action Fund seek a dynamic and data-driven Senior Vice President of Development Data, Operations, and Technology (SVP). As a core member of Development’s Senior Leadership team, the SVP reports to Chief Development Officer (CDO) Leora Hanser in the Development division of PPFA. This role is the backbone of Planned Parenthood’s philanthropic efforts, ensuring that the infrastructure supporting PPFA’s fundraising is robust, efficient, scalable, and best-in-class. The SVP provides the strategic roadmap for the foundational systems, data architecture, and insights that empower fundraising strategy and builds a cohesive development operations function in service of the National Office and Federation fundraising goals.
The SVP is a newly created role reflecting the prioritization of development data, operations, and technology as a suite of strategic functions – above and beyond process alone – to drive decision-making and optimize fundraising. They have accountability for the following: development technology strategy, development data governance, CRM administration and optimization, fundraising analytics and business intelligence, prospect research and prospect management, revenue operations and gift processing, development reporting, development technology vendor strategy, and the development systems roadmap and investment priorities. The SVP leads a team of approximately 62 professionals. This leader will join Planned Parenthood as it reimagines its development program and consolidates operations and technology functions – once dispersed across multiple fundraising channels – within the National Office. Desired outcomes include improved data quality and governance, increased fundraising efficiency, improved reporting timeliness, reduced manual processing, increased fundraiser adoption of tools, improved donor retention and conversion insights, and strong service-level performance. The SVP is a key thought partner to the CDO in enhancing Planned Parenthood’s philanthropic impact, ensuring that data-informed strategies are leveraged for all fundraising channels.
Planned Parenthood raised approximately $390M from all sources during FY26.

Purpose:

  • Provides strategic leadership for all the technical and data strategy functions that are foundational to the ability of PPFA multi-channel marketing and philanthropy functions to innovate, scale, and grow fundraising capabilities.
  • Directs the creation of cutting-edge operational solutions and data-forward practices that position Development as a leader in operational excellence within and outside Planned Parenthood.
  • Unifies all development technical and data operations functions into a cohesive, and high-impact division that scales with the organization’s ambitions.
  • Provides data-strategy and analytics support to the Philanthropy and Federation Fundraising verticals, as well as the overall divisional strategy.
  • In collaboration with the Philanthropy and Federation verticals, leads the enterprise-wide donor data strategy, ensuring that advanced analytics and business intelligence directly inform fundraising, resource allocation, and organizational growth.
  • Establishes and maintains enterprise fundraising data governance policies, standards, and stewardship practices that ensure data quality, consistency, security, and compliance across PPFA and affiliate fundraising activities.
  • Builds a culture of exceptional service delivery to fundraising strategists within the Federation and Philanthropy verticals, as well as to affiliate partners, to ensure the timely, accurate, and donor centric execution of fundraising campaigns and data operations at scale within the National office and across the Federation.
  • As a member of the Senior Development Leadership Team (SDLT), the SVP influences strategic decisions across Development, in service of a unified Development strategy and models PPFA’s values in leading the division.

    • Engagement:

  • Partners with the COO, CFO, General Counsel, CIO, and other leaders to ensure concurrence with interdivisional priorities and operational effectiveness in fundraising technical and data practices.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact and bridge between Development and key corporate functions, including Finance, Office of the General Counsel (OGC), and IT.
  • Leads with deep empathy and a proven track record of modernizing fundraising operations for greater impact, and leading changes in business processes and workflow.
  • Develops Federation-wide strategies, standards, and service models that support data sharing, reporting consistency, and technology enablement across independently governed affiliate organizations.
  • The SVP must be an expert in internal partnership, working closely with peer vertical leaders to ensure that operational workflows empower fundraising success.
  • Motivates and champions their team to explore innovative approaches to challenges experienced in the Philanthropy sector.

    • Delivery:

  • Drives strategic vision and direction for all fundraising technical and data operations functions.
  • Leads the recruitment, development, and retention of a diverse team of professionals, fostering an environment of innovation, engagement, and sustained excellence.
  • Partners with executive leadership to advance a culture that embraces change, fosters teamwork, and prioritizes belonging, ensuring the team is equipped to grow, innovate, and pivot.
  • Leads the department through complex transitions, including system migrations, process re-engineering, and data-informed decision-making.
  • Upholds and evolves technical and data operational standards within the division by ensuring accountability and consistent service delivery levels for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Identifies and reduces workflow and technical bottlenecks in the donor lifecycle, from prospect research and gift intake to gifts acknowledgement and reporting.
  • Leads the enterprise-wide donor data strategy.
  • Leads an innovative approach to fundraising technology, with a focus on staying ahead of industry trends to ensure PPFA utilizes state-of-the-art tools for donor engagement; evaluates and deploys emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, predictive analytics, and automation solutions, to strengthen donor engagement, operational efficiency, and fundraising performance.
  • Strategically direct departmental budgets and investments in technology, ensuring that resource allocation is directly tied to long-term revenue projections; responsible for technology contracts, vendor management, procurement strategy, software evaluation, and build-versus-buy decisions.
  • Serves as a key voice in the National Office leadership, and contributes to the overall Development division strategy, in partnership with peers, by developing reporting and analytics resources that support fundraising strategy and inform revenue projections and resource allocation.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

    • Candidate Profile

    PPFA will consider a broad range of backgrounds. The ideal candidate will align with the following qualifications:

  • A deep commitment to Planned Parenthood’s mission and to an inclusive and equitable work environment.
  • Minimum 20 years of experience in fundraising operations, with at least eight years in a senior leadership role within a large, complex nonprofit; experience working in federated, multi-entity, membership, affiliate, or similarly complex organizational structures strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional ability to translate complex data sets into actionable fundraising strategies and clear executive-level reporting.
  • Leadership experience in master data management, data governance, data operations, data privacy and compliance reporting.
  • Deep expertise in complex marketing or fundraising technical stacks, including the following: CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), data warehouses, customer data platforms, digital marketing platforms, business intelligence tools, payment processors, and the integration of third-party fundraising platforms.
  • Strong ability to build alliances with peer leaders and navigate the needs of business units like finance and legal.
  • Proven track record of managing large-scale organizational change and process improvement initiatives; experience leading enterprise system implementations, CRM transformations, data modernization initiatives, and organizational redesign efforts.
  • A ‘systems thinker’ with a relentless focus on streamlining workflows and establishing rigorous operational standards.
  • A commitment to providing exceptional internal service delivery, viewing the Development Data Operations and Technology team as partners in the success of the frontline fundraisers.
  • A proven track record of leading with empathy when leading change, while navigating challenging or high-pressure organizational dynamics.
  • Ability to lead a diverse team of passionate fundraising operations professionals and developing talent.
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in business, information systems, or nonprofit management preferred.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Integrations)
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (Integrations)

Department: R&D

Location: Prague

Employment Type: FullTime

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Integrations team. In this role, you'll drive the architecture, development, and scalability of backend systems and APIs that connect our platform with the wider ecosystem. We value innovation and are seeking someone eager to bring fresh ideas – especially around integration patterns, API design, and cloud-native backend architectures.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner across departments (Product, Integrations, and Platform teams) and work with external partners to evaluate technical trade-offs and guide direction.

  • Proactively identify cross-team technical risks and implement backend process and system improvements.

  • Use data and observability insights to drive architectural decisions, optimize performance, and measure system impact.

  • Design, build, and evolve backend architectures and APIs focused on reliability, performance, and scalability.

  • Review backend code to set high standards and mentor engineers through design feedback, RFCs, and technical guidance.

Who You Are

  • Relevant experience as a backend engineer working on production systems and distributed architectures.

  • A customer-first mindset supported by data-driven decision-making when designing scalable APIs.

  • A passion for continuous learning, coaching, and team development through code reviews and technical mentorship.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive, ownership-focused, and empathetic approach.

  • Proven track record in API design, handling failure modes, and managing technical debt in production environments.

What Success Looks Like

Within 3 Months:

  • Fully onboarded into the Rossum ecosystem and building relationships across the team.

  • Gaining a deep understanding of our synergy with Coupa and our shared roadmap.

  • Building a solid grasp of Rossum’s backend architecture and identifying initial technical risks or improvement opportunities in the Integrations domain.

Within 6 Months:

  • Independently managing key responsibilities and identifying areas for strategic improvement.

  • Actively participating in the alignment of processes within the new Coupa organizational structure.

  • Leading the design and delivery of significant backend integration initiatives while raising architectural consistency across teams.

Within 12 Months:

  • Recognized as a subject matter expert within the team, navigating the global Coupa ecosystem.

  • Successfully contributing to Rossum’s mission at a massive scale using new global resources.

  • Ensuring backend services scale reliably with customer usage while establishing shared engineering best practices.

Why Join Us?

At Rossum, we’re on a mission to free the world from boring manual data entry. Our AI platform helps companies save millions of hours, allowing professionals to focus on creative, impactful work.

In an exciting move for our future, we have joined forces with Coupa, the world’s leading unified platform for Business Spend Management. By combining Rossum’s cutting-edge document AI with Coupa’s global ecosystem, we are uniquely positioned to redefine how businesses operate at a massive scale. You can read more about this exciting milestone and our shared vision in the official announcement here.

What sets us apart?

  • Cutting-edge AI technology reshaping how businesses operate globally.

  • A collaborative, supportive environment where autonomy thrives.

  • Opportunities to grow in a fast-scaling company.

  • A culture that values diversity, empathy, and genuine connection.

As part of the Coupa family, you’ll enjoy: the agility of a fast-moving, innovation-focused team with the stability and reach of a global market leader. For you, this means an even greater opportunity to make an impact, access new global markets, and grow your career within a collaborative culture that values autonomy, diversity, and genuine connection. Together, we’re not just automating data—we’re giving time back to the world’s professionals.

What We Offer (Benefits)

Future with Coupa: We are currently in an integration phase, during which we are reviewing and aligning our total rewards programs. Our goal is to blend Rossum’s local culture with Coupa’s global standards to provide you with a long-term future featuring clear career pathways, tailored learning journeys, and world-class development opportunities.

What we offer

  • Work-Life Harmony: 5 weeks of vacation, 5 sick/personal days, and a Birthday Day Off to celebrate you. For new parents, we offer an extra 18 weeks of fully paid Maternity leave and 8 weeks of fully paid Paternity leave.

  • Flexibility: Hybrid work model with flexible hours—find the balance that works best for you and work how you work best.

  • Tech & Setup: High-end laptop (MacBook) and tech setup. We also support you with personal development, including language lessons (English & Czech, on all levels).

  • Community & Well-being: Wellness Days (company-wide days to unplug, reset, and recharge), MultSport cards, regular team offsites, and meetups, in a friendly, ambitious team environment.

title: Senior Cloud Native Security Architect
description: **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. **Job Summary** As a member of the Cloud Native Security Services team you'll work directly with Idira (formerly CyberArk) customers to understand, plan, and implement complex product use cases across business critical environments. Our team has a long history as Cloud and Kubernetes consultants, with our customers' needs central to our success. Today we continue that work within Idira, bringing our industry expertise to help customers realise the value they need from our products, whilst informing future releases with direct insights from the field. We are a remote first team with no current expectation to travel on a regular basis. We like to meet in-person as often as we can, with opportunities to come to the London office roughly once a month, and bigger team meet-ups planned a few times a year. Currently we're working with Idira Secrets Management, Workload Identity, and Agentic Security product teams; developing custom integrations and navigating complex deployment environments, whilst acting as the customers embedded product and domain subject matter experts. Where others specialise in fast and efficient product enablement, we target the most complex customer environments and use cases, requiring both broad and deep industry and domain experience. We prefer to work directly with customer teams, collaborating with stakeholders across operations, security and engineering teams. We care deeply about fostering a diverse team of individuals and encourage all to apply, even if you're unsure of your qualifications or fit. We would love to hear from you and appreciate you taking the time to apply. **The Role** As a Senior Cloud Native Security Architect you will repeatedly face new and difficult challenges. Your ability to remain composed and collaborative, whilst you work with your team to find solutions will be the biggest determining factor in your success in the role. Perfect execution is never our target; instead we aim to leave the customer closer to their goals and further from ambiguity, all whilst providing an exceptional customer experience. **You will be expected to:** + Lead customer engagements incl. scoping work, directing other team members, acting as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, running calls and workshops, and providing regular project updates. + Pro-actively initiate and contribute to internal initiatives. + Consistently apply (and confidently speak on) cloud security best practices + Actively engage in team/group level strategy and goal setting activities. + Act as a peer mentor to your fellow team members. incl. providing regular feedback for personal and professional development. **You will succeed in this role if you:** + Are comfortable working directly with customer stakeholders at all levels (i.e. senior management - individual contributors). + Are able to effectively empathise with and translate between stakeholders across different domains (i.e. infosec, operations, product R&D, senior leadership). + Enjoy working in complex (and often ambiguous) problem domains. Helping customers determine what they _actually_ want and need, then designing and implementing pragmatic solutions to get them there. + Show up to calls with empathy, patience, positivity, and the desire to collaborate towards shared goals. + Easily move between different levels of abstraction (high level architecture and solution design - implementation detail and configuration). + Enjoy learning and can quickly become a subject matter expert in previously unfamiliar domains. + Inspire confidence and restore calm in otherwise tense or strained situations (i.e. managing unhappy customer stakeholders and high impact service outages). + Approach challenges pragmatically, preferring actions that produce meaningful customer value over polish and philosophical alignment. **Qualifications** **The Tech** We work with an extremely broad range of tools and technologies, mostly cloud centric, and often open source (i.e. CNCF projects). As such, we often take on work in domains where we're not yet experts, and instead must learn what's needed in the moment, relying on a set of foundational best practices to guide us. That said, there are a few technologies that come up time and time again for which hands-on experience and a good understanding proves extremely valuable. These are in approximate order of importance: + Kubernetes - self-managed (Openshift, K3s, etc.) and cloud managed (GKE, Autopilot, EKS, etc.) + Container runtimes (Docker / containerd / podman) + SPIFFE / SPIRE (for workload identity) + Linux / Unix operating systems (RHEL / Rocky Linux / Ubuntu / Debian) + Cloud networking (VPCs, firewalls,network peering, VPNs) + Cloud IAM (predominantly GCP and AWS) + Cloud databases (Cloud SQL, Spanner, DynamoDB, Bigtable, etc.) + Golang / Python (for gluing services and deployment scripting) + Terraform / Crossplane / Config Connector (GCP) / CloudFormation (AWS) (for deploying and managing cloud infrastructure) + Git (for source control) + Github Actions / Jenkins (for CI) + Argo CD / Flux (for CD) + Vault / Conjur (for secrets management) We don't expect candidates to be experts in all of these, but a strong foundation of security best practices, and a working knowledge of Kubernetes and the major cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, etc.) will be essential. Experience with any of the others is a huge advantage. Once again, we encourage you to apply if this work sounds at all interesting to you. We have the ability to offer positions at lower levels if we think the fit is good but your experience needs development. We have capacity in the team to mentor and would always prefer an enthusiastic candidate and a great team fit than lots of experience but a poor fit. Thanks for taking the time to read through this spec and we look forward to hearing from you! **Our Commitment** We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com . Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

You will also play an important role in helping shape and develop The Config Team's project management capability, supporting continuous improvement, talent development, and delivery excellence across the business.

  • Strong commercial awareness with experience managing project budgets, forecasts, risks, and contractual obligations.

  • Experience working within dynamic, matrixed organisations and managing cross-functional project teams.

We currently have an exciting opportunity for Data Scientist – Machine Learning, to join our Enterprise Analytics team. In this role, you will work with stakeholders across the organization, including Data Engineering teams. You will leverage your Technical, Analytical, and Business acumen to help data-driven decision-making. title: Sr. Principal Product Manager
description:
Sr. Principal Product Manager

Location: Remote - US

Department: Product Management

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work :

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Principal Product Manager- Developer Platform

About the job

Twilio is looking for a Senior Principal, Product Management to deliver our strategic vision for the Developer Platform. You will manage foundational services, APIs, and infrastructure, driving the roadmap that empowers internal teams and partners to scale confidently.

You will treat the platform as a product, shifting platform engineering from reactive, ad-hoc support into proactive, self-service experiences. Grounded in industry research (DORA, CNCF, Team Topologies, etc..), you will introduce golden paths, a discoverable developer portal, self-service tools, and high-quality documentation to reduce cognitive load and support burdens across Twilio.

Collaborating with product leaders, engineering, architecture, and design, you will define the future of developer experience, tooling, deployment, and operational capabilities, acting as the steward for evangelizing our developer platform capabilities and narrative and driving roadmap prioritization across a scalable cloud platform.

The right candidate is a visionary product leader who thrives at the intersection of commerce, growth, and customer experience. You’ll set the long-term strategy for Twilio’s Commerce Platform, build a world-class PM team, and partner closely with engineering and cross-functional leaders to deliver innovative solutions that fuel Twilio’s growth.

Key Skills

  • Platform-as-a-Product Expertise: Proficiency in applying product management methodologies—including user research, roadmapping, and KPI definition—to internal infrastructure.
  • Architectural & Technical Fluency: Deep understanding of cloud-native technologies (Kubernetes, microservices, CI/CD) and observability frameworks, enabling credible engagement with engineering leads.
  • Developer Experience Design: Proven ability to identify developer friction points and architect solutions like developer portals, golden paths, and documentation-as-code to drive self-service.
  • Stakeholder Influence & Evangelism: Capacity to build compelling narratives that align cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Security) and drive internal platform adoption.
  • Performance Analytics: Experience defining and using success metrics (DORA, adoption, reliability) to advocate for data-driven product strategies.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own the Platform Roadmap: Define and drive the multi-quarter strategy for foundational services, ensuring the roadmap balances technical debt, scalability, and new feature velocity.
  • Transition to Self-Service: Actively shift the platform from reactive, 'ticket-based' support to a scalable, proactive product model by establishing paved roads and service catalogs.
  • Lead Cross-functional Integration: Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Security leads to ensure platform solutions are extensible, compliant, and meet the unique needs of internal developers.
  • Drive Developer Productivity: Champion continuous improvements in APIs, SDKs, and sandbox environments to reduce time-to-first-deploy and cognitive load.
  • Measure and Optimize: Establish governance frameworks and KPI dashboards to track adoption, support deflection, and reliability, iteratively refining the platform based on usage data and developer feedback.
  • Customer focus: Deeply understand customer needs and advocate for customer-centric product & engineering practices, using developer interviews and usage data to translate requests into root causes.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the voice of the Twilio platform across the organization (internal development platform, deployment systems, developer experience and tooling, etc.), ensuring stakeholder needs are well understood and incorporated into the product planning process.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 12+ years of product management experience building large scale cloud services platforms; specifically building cloud native commerce systems for usage-based and metered products at a very large scale
  • 10+ years people management experience with demonstrated ability to encourage/lead/recruit/retain successful product management teams
  • Proven track record of results including establishing ambitious goals, achieving /over-achieving those goals and taking overall responsibility for customer and business outcomes
  • A track record of driving companies through ground-breaking change with the ability to see the big-picture while also being hands-on in the details
  • Executive presence with strong communication skills, and ability to communicate business value and product features/benefits and influence at the highest levels to drive change
  • Data-driven, outcomes oriented and a problem solver
  • Customer obsessed - passionate about the customer journey and the customer experience
  • Experience building large scale, mission critical software services like a Commerce system or similar
  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university, or equivalent experience

Travel:

  • We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 15% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in The Bay Area or Seattle area

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C.: $233,100.00–$259,000.00
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $246,780.00–$274,200.00
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $274,140.00–$304,600.00

This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 8/24/2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. title: Commercial Application Engineer
description:
Commercial Application Engineer

Location: Remote, Longmont

Remote Type: Fully Remote

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Job Description Summary

The Opportunity
If you're someone who loves being at the intersection of deep technical knowledge and the thrill of winning a deal, this role was built for you. At GE Vernova's Software & Control Solutions (SCS) business, we design and deliver industrial control systems and digital solutions that keep power plants and grid operators running — safer, smarter, and more reliably across the globe.
As a Commercial Application Engineer (CAE), you'll be the connective tissue between what customers need and what we can build. You'll lead complex, high-stakes proposals from first contact through contract, bringing together sales, engineering, finance, and risk teams to craft technically sound, commercially competitive solutions. This is a role where curiosity, precision, and commercial instinct come together — and where the work you do directly shapes how GE Vernova grows.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end proposal development for core and complex industrial control system offerings — from reviewing customer specifications, requests for proposals (RFPs), and requests for quotations (RFQs) to submitting fully costed, technically tailored bids on time.
  • Own deal financials and risk management, including technical, execution, and commercial risk assessment within the inquiry-to-order (ITO) process — and present deals to the Commercial Review Board (CRB) for approval.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, channel partners, and internal stakeholders throughout the proposal lifecycle, providing application engineering guidance and driving alignment across teams.
  • Develop competitive pricing and deal strategy in partnership with the sales and pricing teams, leveraging quoting tools, technical libraries, hardware configurations, and design standards to build differentiated solutions.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with supply chain, third-party providers, and execution teams — including managing the handover from the ITO phase to the order-to-remittance (OTR) phase upon contract signature.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of commercial processes, proposal templates, and application guides — and actively track performance against key commercial metrics including proposal quality, cycle time, and on-time delivery.

Who You Are

You're a technically grounded problem-solver who thrives in a fast-moving, deal-driven environment. You bring a strong foundation in industrial controls — and you're equally comfortable in a pricing conversation as you are reviewing a system architecture. You know how to move a deal forward, keep stakeholders aligned, and deliver a compelling proposal under pressure.

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or a related field — or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience (see below)
  • Proven experience in technical sales, commercial proposals, or application engineering within industrial controls, power generation, or a related technical domain
  • Demonstrated ability to read and interpret technical specifications, customer drawings, and contractual terms and conditions
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical and commercial content to diverse stakeholder audiences

Preferred

  • Experience with industrial control systems (e.g., distributed control systems (DCS), programmable logic controllers (PLCs), or SCADA — supervisory control and data acquisition)
  • Familiarity with project risk management frameworks and commercial review processes
  • Experience managing tender schedules and multi-stakeholder bid processes

Why GE Vernova

GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. Our Software & Control Solutions team operates at the frontier of industrial technology — and the problems we solve have real consequences for energy reliability, safety, and the transition to a cleaner grid.

We offer varied, competitive benefits designed to reward high performers and support you and your family. We invest in your career through on-the-job learning, development programs, and the opportunity to grow your expertise across a global business. A healthy, balanced lifestyle means different things to different people — and we've built programs to support the way you live and work today.

Additional Information

GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

About the Role

Cox Automotive is modernizing the dealership accounting experience as part of the DMS+ platform strategy. The Director of Product Management for Accounting will own the product strategy and execution for DMS+ Accounting, leading a team of Product Managers responsible for the PDLC of Accounting: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, period close, deal posting, Journal Workbench, and adjacent workflows.

Team & Portfolio Leadership

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Apply and evolve Cox Data framework as it relates to accounting data integrity and downstream reporting.

Market & Competitive Insight

description:
Associate/Cybersecurity & Incident Response (Forensic Services practice)

Location: Boston, MA, United States; Chicago, IL, United States; Dallas, Texas, United States; Houston, Texas, United States; New York, NY, United States; Oakland, CA, United States; Washington, DC, United States

Department: Forensic Services

About Charles River Associates

CRA is a leading global consulting firm that provides independent economic and financial analysis behind litigation matters, guides businesses through critical strategy and operational issues to become more profitable, and advises governments on the economic impact of policies and regulations. Our two main services – economic and management consulting – are delivered by practice groups that focus on specific areas of expertise or industries. Click here to learn how CRA can help you launch your career.

Position Overview

CRA’s Forensic Services practice supports companies’ commitment to integrity by assisting them and their counsel in independently responding to allegations of fraud, waste, abuse, misconduct, and non-compliance. We are noted for deploying cross-trained teams of forensic professionals to assist our clients in gaining deeper insights and greater value more quickly. We provide accounting and forensic services as well as cybercrime investigation services. We value knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, research experience, quantitative ability, exceptional written and oral communication skills, and a high level of initiative. We expect Associates to use data to solve client problems, work collaboratively with a team, effectively manage their time, prioritize tasks, and take pride and ownership in their work.

The opportunities to contribute to the Forensics team in this role may include (but are not limited to):

  • Executing security and privacy investigations for CRA clients, in preparation of, and in response to, data security matters, which may include ongoing breach detection, threat analysis, incident response and malware analysis;
  • Providing expert digital forensic support for counsel and clients in support of data security incidents, such as data breaches or fraud;
  • Assisting in the drafting of forensic reports, affidavits and testifying as an expert in the field of digital forensics and incident response;
  • Engaging in problem-solving and forensic analysis of digital information using standard evidence handling techniques and computer forensics tools;
  • Identify, research, and organize information to assess the appropriateness and sufficiency of available data to facilitate effective data access and analysis;
  • Developing familiarity with data that serves as input to this analysis, including threat intelligence, logging data, as well as contextual clues;
  • Recognizing relationships among multiple sources and types of information to facilitate effective data analysis;
  • Programming, model building, and database administration (Python, T-SQL, VBA, Excel, C#, among others);
  • Ensuring reliability of analysis and risk management through implementing quality control measures and documentation;
  • Forensically acquire data and images from identified hosts, and then locate evidence of compromise determine its impact from disk, file, memory, and log analysis;
  • Identify artifact and evidence locations to answer critical questions, including execution, file access, data theft, anti-forensics, and detailed system usage by an adversary;
  • Detect and hunt unknown live, dormant, and custom malware across multiple hosts in an enterprise environment;
  • Create Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) from analysis to strengthen incident response and threat intelligence efforts;
  • Track adversary activity second-by-second on a host via in-depth timeline analysis;
  • Understand the evidence needed to determine the type of malware used in an attack, including rootkits, backdoors, and Trojan horses, choosing appropriate defenses and response tactics for each;
  • Identify lateral movement and pivots within client enterprises, showing how an adversary transitions from system to system without detection;
  • Use physical memory analysis tools to determine an adversary's activities on a host and other hosts the adversary used as pivot points across the network;
  • Examine traffic using common network protocols to identify patterns of activity or specific actions that warrant further investigation;
  • Identify and track malware beaconing outbound to its command and control (C2) channel via memory forensics, registry analysis, and network connections;
  • Providing technical assessment/audit and guidance to clients on the adequacy of cyber security controls in accordance with cybersecurity frameworks that are included in one or more of the following - NIST CSF 2.0, HIPAA, ISO 27001 and 27002, SOC2, NERC-CIP;
  • Participating in practice-building activities including recruiting and training.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with a relevant academic focus (Computer Science, Digital Forensics, Information Security and/or Information Systems)
    • This is an immediate opening, current students should apply to our campus postings;
  • 2-4 years of relevant work experience in financial/economic analysis, preferably in a consulting firm (we are accepting applications from recent graduates and candidates in the workforce)
    • Recent graduates or individuals without directly relevant experience may be hired into the Analyst title;
  • Digital forensics/incident response training and certifications, including SANS GIAC (GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, GIME), IACIS (CFCE or CIFR), Magnet MCFE, X-ways X-Pert or similar;
  • Strong understanding of computer operating systems, software and hardware;
  • Ability to conduct detailed forensic investigations and analysis of computers, networks, mobile devices and removable media;
  • Experience with conducting digital forensic analysis using commercial and open source forensic tools. Including file system forensics, memory analysis and network analysis;
  • Experience with conducting static/dynamic malware analysis in a lab environment and threat hunting in a live environment;
  • Experience in collegiate computer security competitions;
  • Strong understanding of proper evidence handling procedures and chain of custody;
  • Experience with drafting technical and investigative reports and communicating technical findings;
  • Experience with utilizing automation tools and scripts to expedite analysis;
  • Understanding incident handling procedures: preparation, identification, containment, eradication, and recovery-to protect enterprise environments;
  • Understanding of common attack techniques used by an adversary on a victim network and leveraging those techniques to stop further adversary activity.

To Apply

To be considered for a position in the United States, we require the following:

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals;
  • Transcript – may be unofficial.

If you are interested in applying for one of our international locations, please visit our Careers site to view and apply for available jobs.

Career Growth and Benefits

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering 100 hours of training annually through formal and informal programs, encourage you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with research and analysis skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognize that individuals realize a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Salary and other compensation

A good-faith estimate of the annual base salary range for this position is $92,500 - $105,000. Starting pay within this range may vary based on factors such as education level, experience, skills, geographic location, market conditions, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position may be eligible for additional bonus incentive compensation.

title: Brandskyddssamordnare
description:
Boliden är ett högteknologiskt metallföretag med egna gruvor och smältverk som arbetar långsiktigt med att garantera samhällets tillgång till bas- och ädelmetaller. I ett sekel har vårt arbete varit en del av de värdekedjor som format det moderna samhället. På Boliden vet vi att metallerna vi bryter och tillgängliggör kommer att spela en avgörande roll även framöver - det som spelar roll är hur vi framställer dem. Bli en del av oss och driv förändring för kommande generationer.

Brandskyddssamordnare till Anrikningsverket, Bolidenområdet

Vill du arbeta nära verksamheten och vara med och utveckla ett strukturerat och framtidssäkert brandskyddsarbete? Vi söker en Brandskyddssamordnare som vill hålla ihop och följa upp vårt brandskydds- och nödlägesarbete på Anrikningsverket och i Maurliden som är en del av Bolidenområdet. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera praktiskt arbete i verksamheten med struktur, koordinering och utveckling – i en roll där du verkligen gör skillnad.

Din roll

I rollen som Brandskyddssamordnare ansvarar du för att samordna och vidareutveckla brandskyddsarbetet i vår verksamhet. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt med att skapa struktur, följa upp aktiviteter och stötta organisationen. En viktig del av uppdraget är att samordna arbetet mellan olika funktioner och säkerställa att vi tillsammans håller en hög nivå inom brandskydd och beredskap. Rollen innebär en kombination av kontorsarbete och närvaro ute i verksamheten, till exempel vid ronder och övningar. Arbetstiden är dagtid, måndag till fredag, och rollen kräver i huvudsak närvaro på plats.

Ditt team

Du tillhör ett mindre team med placering på Anrikningsverket och samarbetar nära flera funktioner inom verksamheten. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, både internt och externt, exempelvis med räddningstjänst och andra samarbetspartners.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Samordna och utveckla brandskyddsarbetet i verksamheten

  • Följa upp åtgärder, aktiviteter och beslut kopplade till brandskydd

  • Ansvara för struktur och uppdatering av brandskyddsdokumentation

  • Planera och följa upp nödlägesövningar

  • Vara ett stöd och rådgivande i brand- och säkerhetsfrågor

  • Samverka med interna funktioner och externa parter

  • Bidra till att skapa en tydlig och fungerande struktur i arbetssätt och uppföljning

Ditt bidrag

Du är en person som trivs i en samordnande roll där du får arbeta strukturerat, bygga relationer och driva frågor framåt tillsammans med andra. Du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och tycker om att skapa ordning och tydlighet i komplexa sammanhang.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Eftergymnasial utbildning, exempelvis brandingenjör eller annan utbildning inom brand, säkerhet eller motsvarande erfarenhet

  • Erfarenhet av brandskyddsarbete eller närliggande område

  • God förmåga att kommunicera muntligt och skriftligt på svenska och goda kunskaper i engelska

  • God datorvana

  • B-körkort

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • Erfarenhet från industri eller liknande verksamhet

  • Erfarenhet av projekt, samordning eller utvecklingsarbete

Vi ser gärna att du är i början av din karriär alternativt att du vill utvecklas vidare inom området – hos oss finns möjlighet att växa in i rollen.

Varför arbeta tillsammans med oss

På Boliden tror vi på att främja en arbetsplats där omsorg, mod och ansvar är centralt i allt vi gör. Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats där vi tror på samarbete och där det du bidrar med kommer att ha en direkt inverkan på kommande generationer. Vi är ett företag som består av ansvarsfulla och kreativa människor som alla jobbar mot samma vision; att bli den mest hållbara och respekterade metalleverantören i världen.

Ansök idag för att bli en del av något verkligt meningsfullt!

Hos oss på Boliden är mångfald och inkludering en drivkraft för innovation. Vi vet att olika perspektiv och erfarenheter stärker oss och hjälper oss att ligga i framkant i en viktig och spännande bransch. Därför uppmuntrar vi ansökningar från människor med olika bakgrunder och synsätt. Tillsammans bygger vi en arbetsplats där alla kan känna sig trygga och inspirerade att nå sin fulla potential.

Vill du veta mer om rollen?
Kontakta rekryterande chef Lisa Andersson, lisa.andersson@boliden.com, 070-813 24 53. Frågor om din ansökan besvaras av vår Talent Acquisition Partner Charlotte Lindkvist, charlotte.lindkvist@boliden.com. Facklig information får du av: Mats Lindblom (SACO) 073-350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson (Unionen) 070-541 83 93 och Peter Markström (Ledarna) 0910-77 40 09.

description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership – Lead the design and development of end‑to‑end application features across backend services (Java 21) and frontend applications (Angular). Own architecture decisions spanning APIs, UI state management, performance, security, and scalability. Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and best practices across both backend and frontend stacks.
  • Backend Responsibilities (Java) – Design and implement backend services using Java (17/21+), Spring Boot, and related Spring frameworks. Build and maintain RESTful APIs and service integrations consumed by Angular frontends. Lead backend architecture using microservices, event‑driven designs, and cloud‑native patterns.
  • Frontend Responsibilities (Angular) – Lead development of frontend applications using Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, and modern component‑based architecture. Design responsive, accessible, and performant UI components aligned with UX and product requirements. Define frontend architecture, including state management, routing, lazy loading, and API consumption.
  • Quality, Testing & Reliability – Promote automated testing across the stack: backend unit, integration, and contract tests (JUnit, Mockito); frontend unit and component tests (Jasmine, Karma, Jest). Champion observability using structured logging, metrics, and tracing across frontend and backend. Ensure applications are secure, resilient, and production‑ready with proper validation, error handling, and monitoring.
  • DevOps & Deployment – Support CI/CD pipelines for both UI and backend components. Partner with DevOps on Docker and Kubernetes deployments, environment configuration, and release processes. Ensure artifacts are versioned, deployed, and monitored consistently. Participate in production support, incident reviews, and reliability improvements.
  • Team Leadership & Mentorship – Mentor engineers across frontend and backend disciplines, promoting full‑stack skill growth. Lead technical design reviews and code reviews across Java and Angular codebases. Encourage knowledge sharing and establish best practices for full‑stack development. Support hiring and onboarding of full‑stack engineers through interviews and guidance.
  • Collaboration & Delivery – Work closely with product managers, UX designers, QA, and platform teams. Drive sprint planning, estimation, and timely delivery of full‑stack features. Communicate technical decisions, risks, and trade‑offs clearly to stakeholders. Balance hands‑on development with leadership responsibilities.

Expectations

  • Customer Focused – Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions.
  • Managing Risk – Assess and effectively manage all risks associated with business objectives and activities to ensure alignment with the Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

  • Preferred Skills – Angular, Application Development, Business Management, Customer Solutions, Design, Front‑End Development, Group Problem Solving, Java, Process Improvements, Release Management, Software Solutions, Technical Leadership, User Experience Design.
  • Competencies – Application Delivery Process, Application Design, Architecture, Application Development Tools, Application Testing, Packaged Application Integration, System Development Life Cycle, Technical Troubleshooting.
  • Work Experience – 3+ years of relevant direct industry experience. A comparable combination of education, job‑specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Education – Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Certifications – None required.

Benefits

PNC offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical and prescription drug coverage with a Health Savings Account feature, dental and vision options, life insurance, short‑term and long‑term disability protection, 401(k) with match, pension and stock purchase plans, dependent care reimbursement, educational assistance, a robust wellness program with financial incentives, as well as paid time off that may include maternity or parental leave, holidays, occasional absence days, and vacation days that increase with career level and years of service.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

PNC provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other categories protected by law. This position is subject to relevant federal and state licensing and regulatory requirements.

Disability Accommodations

If an accommodation is required to participate in the application process, please contact us via email at AccommodationRequest@pnc.com including the subject line “accommodation request” and your name, job ID, and preferred contact method. You may also call 877‑968‑7762 and say “Workday.” All information provided will be kept confidential and used only to the extent required to provide reasonable accommodations.

Cobalt Service Partners is looking for a full-time Vice President of Operations to lead operations at one of our partner companies in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role, you will own field team execution, subcontractor relationships, and cost and budget oversight, reporting directly to the CEO. You'll help build the operating structure and processes for a business that is scaling quickly, standardizing systems, developing standard operating procedures, and driving operational discipline across the organization. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in field services, trades, or security/low-voltage operations, with real profit and loss ownership, experience managing subcontractor relationships, and a track record of building process in fast-growing organizations.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day operational execution across field teams delivering security systems, access control, and related field service work.

  • Own the operational side of the P&L, including budgeting, cost oversight, and cash management, in partnership with finance.

  • Direct profit and loss ownership, revenue and cost, not solely budget or cost-center management.
  • Experience managing subcontractor relationships, including vetting, contracts, and accountability for quality and schedule.
  • Experience building or scaling operations in a smaller, fast-moving organization, with strong process and SOP-building skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Direct reporting relationship with the CEO and real influence over operations

title: Industrial Designer
description:
About Re:Build Manufacturing and Re:Build Tekna:

Tekna was founded in 1988 in the heart of Southwest Michigan where creative vision and hard work laid the foundation for a business that continues to grow in a rapidly evolving industry. The rigor and attention to detail that comes with designing for the medical industry has awarded us success in supporting both major companies and start-ups from early stage development to commercialization. The same principles apply as we’ve expanded to serve customers in a wide variety of other industries including consumer and industrial goods, electronics, and appliances. Tekna’s project portfolio is incredibly diverse covering medical, life science, consumer and industrial product categories. Tekna is largely client focused offering design consulting, contract manufacturing and original equipment manufacturing services. Tekna’s cross functional teams include Design Engineering, Industrial Design, CAD, Procurement, Production and Quality which offers a friendly and supportive team atmosphere.

Re:Build Manufacturing is a family of industrial businesses combining cutting-edge enabling technologies, operational superiority, and strategic M&A to build America’s next-generation industrial company. Re:Build leverages deep expertise in operations management and technology to supercharge the performance of its subsidiaries by implementing core technologies across industrial platforms in diversified growth markets. Our goal is to help revitalize the U.S. manufacturing base over the coming decades, creating substantial opportunities for our employees and the communities where we operate.

If you like a fast-paced environment where individuals can stretch and be challenged with a diverse set of projects, we offer a great deal of variety and empower our staff to take on as much responsibility as they can handle, offering a helping hand and experienced-based coaching and the support of a highly competent team. Our goal is to enable our employees to achieve their fullest potential, and through our association with Re:Build, provide avenues for personal and professional growth.

Who we are looking for

The role of an Industrial Designer at Tekna is to provide solutions that address identified user needs, while helping our clients meet their business objectives. Solutions will be developed using a combination of the following tools: market, ergonomic and user scenario research, sketching, rendering, study models, computer models, and final production quality prototypes.

What you'll get to do

  • Work closely with Design and Engineering Leads to scope projects to gain an understanding for clients’ business objectives.
  • Assist in the development of the work approach and strategy.
  • Participate in and lead a variety of research activities.
  • Possess and demonstrate a high skill level in fundamental design tools and practices.
  • Maintain our customer’s corporate look and feel based on material selection, color palette, specific design elements or form vocabulary.

What you bring to the team

  • Bachelors Fine Arts (BFA) or Bachelors Science in Industrial Design (BSID)
  • 3-5 years in corporate or consulting environments.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills, written and verbal.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and proven ability to meet deadlines.

We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate

Description

The OpenShift Engineer is responsible for managing, optimizing, and automating OpenShift container platforms across hybrid cloud environments. This role focuses on OpenShift installation, upgrades, and migrations while ensuring seamless integration with OpenStack, ACM, LDAP, and CI/CD pipelines. The engineer will also support OpenShift Data Foundation (ODF), OpenShift Container Storage (OCS), and Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE).

Key Responsibilities

OpenShift Operations & Administration

• Manage, maintain, and optimize OpenShift clusters in on-prem and cloud environments.

• Perform OpenShift installations, upgrades, and migrations with minimal downtime.

• Implement and manage OpenShift Data Foundation (ODF) and OpenShift Container Storage (OCS) solutions.

• Troubleshoot and resolve OpenShift and Kubernetes-related issues in production and development environments.

• Ensure high availability, scalability, and security across OpenShift platforms.

Hybrid Cloud & Infrastructure Integration

• Work with OpenStack and ACM (Advanced Cluster Management) to streamline multi-cluster management.

• Integrate OpenShift with OpenStack for scalable and efficient cloud operations.

• Deploy and manage Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) workloads as part of hybrid cloud infrastructure.

Security, Identity Management & Compliance

• Configure and manage LDAP integration for customer role-based access control (RBAC).

• Implement security best practices, including authentication, authorization, and container security policies.

• Monitor compliance with security policies and industry best practices for OpenShift and Kubernetes clusters.

CI/CD & Automation

• Design and implement CI/CD pipelines to automate OpenShift deployments and application lifecycle management.

• Develop and maintain automation scripts for OpenShift cluster provisioning and management using Ansible, Terraform, or Helm.

• Collaborate with DevOps teams to optimize containerized workloads and application deployments.

Monitoring & Performance Optimization

• Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions for OpenShift clusters using Prometheus, Grafana, or similar tools.

• Optimize resource utilization and cluster performance to ensure cost efficiency and scalability.

• Perform root cause analysis and proactive troubleshooting of cluster-related incidents.

Collaboration & Documentation

• Work closely with cloud engineers, application developers, and security teams to enhance OpenShift environments.

• Maintain documentation for cluster architecture, automation scripts, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

• Provide training and guidance to internal teams on OpenShift best practices and workflows.

Requirements

Experience: 8+ years in OpenShift operations, administration, and automation.

• Container Platforms: Expertise in OpenShift, Kubernetes, and OpenStack.

• Cloud & Storage: Experience with OpenShift Data Foundation (ODF), OpenShift Container Storage (OCS), and Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE).

• Security & Identity Management: Strong understanding of LDAP integration and RBAC in OpenShift.

• Automation & CI/CD: Experience with GitOps, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD), and Infrastructure as Code (Ansible, Terraform, Helm).

• Monitoring & Logging: Knowledge of Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, and OpenShift monitoring tools.

Preferred Certifications

• Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration

• Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)

• Kubernetes Certified Administrator (CKA)

• OpenStack Administrator Certification

title: Senior Product Manager - Hybrid IT Automation
description:
Location: Remote (European Union)

Reports to: Chief Product Officer

Travel: Quarterly travel to Frankfurt, Germany. Up to 25% additional travel as needed

About Stonebranch:

Stonebranch builds IT orchestration and automation solutions that transform business IT environments from simple IT task automation into sophisticated, real-time business service orchestration. No matter the degree of automation, the Stonebranch platform is simple, modern, and secure. Using Stonebranch Universal Automation Center (UAC), enterprises can seamlessly orchestrate workloads and data across hybrid IT environments. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with points of contact and support throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, Stonebranch serves some of the world’s largest financial, manufacturing, healthcare, travel, transportation, energy, and technology institutions.



Your Part in this Growth Story:

Stonebranch is searching for a hands-on Senior Product Manager to own the product strategy behind our Universal Automation Center platform — someone who translates market opportunity into a roadmap our customers want to buy, and who owns outcomes across the full product lifecycle rather than waiting for direction from the top. Hybrid IT automation is one of the fastest-moving markets in enterprise IT right now, and the roadmap you shape will define how Stonebranch capitalizes on it.

This is a role built for a market at an inflection point. AI is changing both what customers expect from IT automation and how we build the products that deliver it — you'll work alongside an engineering organization that uses AI coding assistants to define, specify, and build new capabilities, and you're expected to spot where AI itself becomes a source of new product value, not just a way to ship existing plans faster.

You'll bring to market best-in-class solutions across Real-Time Hybrid IT Automation, Workload Automation, and Cloud and Data Pipeline Automation, partnering across sales, pre-sales, marketing, services, and support to turn product direction into revenue and renewals. Strong technical grounding in enterprise IT automation is essential — but what sets you apart is range: equally at home shaping a roadmap with engineering, making the business case to executives, and getting into the details of a customer escalation when it counts.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the European Union, with a preference for candidates located near a Stonebranch office. Quarterly travel to our EMEA headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany is required, along with up to 25% additional travel to support customers and events across the regions we serve. This role reports directly to the Chief Product Officer.




Your Impact on the Organization:

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the product roadmap for Universal Automation Center (UAC), translating market opportunity and customer feedback into prioritized initiatives across Workload Automation, Cloud and Data Pipeline Automation, and real-time orchestration
  • Contribute to the strategic product plan — product positioning, competitive strengths and weaknesses, and where the portfolio needs to evolve next
  • Analyze competitive dynamics and win/loss trends to sharpen product direction and inform go-to-market messaging

AI-Driven Product Innovation

  • Identify where AI can create new UAC capabilities, not just accelerate delivery of existing plans
  • Partner with an engineering organization that uses AI coding assistants to define, specify, and build new solutions, translating product vision into requirements those teams can execute against
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML and automation technologies for their potential to extend the UAC product portfolio

Product Launch & Market Execution

  • Lead the launch of new UAC capabilities and the rollout of new versions to market, across both SaaS and private cloud deployments
  • Define and prioritize product requirements within Agile development cycles, gathering input from customers, key stakeholders, and SMEs
  • Represent UAC product strategy directly to customers — in small group settings, at conferences, and through Stonebranch webinars

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication

  • Partner across sales, pre-sales, marketing, services, and support to align product direction with go-to-market execution
  • Communicate the business value of the UAC portfolio to audiences ranging from executives to hands-on users
  • Work through complex customer situations and escalations, bringing product expertise to bear on high-stakes issues



What You Will Bring to the Team:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 10-15 years of professional experience in product management or a closely related discipline
  • 5+ years of experience specifically with Workload Automation (WLA) or adjacent enterprise IT automation domains, either in a Product Management capacity or an adjacent function such as Sales or Services
  • Track record of taking products through some or all of their lifecycle — from requirements definition and roadmapping through launch and market adoption

Technical & Domain Skills

  • Direct experience with Workload Automation, Job Scheduling, or Service Orchestration & Automation Platforms (SOAP); familiarity with Managed File Transfer (MFT) is a plus given the breadth of the Stonebranch platform
  • Experience with SaaS and private/hybrid cloud delivery models, including subscription-based licensing
  • Familiarity with applying AI/GenAI capabilities within a product offering, and experience working alongside engineering teams that use AI-assisted development tools to define and build new capabilities
  • Working knowledge of Agile development methodologies and core PM tradecraft — requirements definition, user stories, acceptance criteria, and PRDs
  • Comfort using product analytics and usage/telemetry data to inform roadmap and licensing decisions
  • Knowledge of data privacy and compliance frameworks such as GDPR is a plus, given close collaboration with EU-based teams, partners, and clients

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Strong customer- and partner-facing presence, with the ability to build trusted-advisor relationships
  • Comfortable representing product strategy externally during customer meetings, conferences, webinars, etc.
  • Effective cross-functional collaborator across sales, pre-sales, marketing, services, and support
  • Clear communicator able to translate technical direction and business value across audiences, from executives to hands-on users
  • Fluency in English (written and verbal) required





Why You’ll Love Stonebranch:

At Stonebranch, you’ll be part of a team that’s passionate about innovation, collaboration, and making an impact in the world of IT automation. We believe great work starts with a great workplace – one that values people, supports growth, and celebrates success.

  • Collaborative Culture: Join an international team of experienced, high-performing professionals who value teamwork, knowledge sharing, and mutual success.
  • Growth & Development: Take advantage of continuous learning opportunities and professional development to advance your career.
  • Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Benefit from a flexible work environment with hybrid or remote options, designed to support balance and productivity.
  • Impact & Innovation: Be part of a high-growth company at the forefront of IT automation, where your contributions directly influence customer success and business outcomes.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Receive a competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with local market standards and employment regulations.
  • Community & Connection: Participate in regular team and company events that foster connection and a strong sense of belonging.
