title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Software Engineer

Department: Software Engineering

Location: San Francisco

Compensation: $155K – $180K • Offers Equity

Employment Type: FullTime

Our Mission

SPAN is enabling electrification for all ⚡

We are a mission-driven company designing, building, and deploying products that electrify the built environment, reduce carbon emissions, and slow the effects of climate change.

  • Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere.

  • Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives.

At SPAN, we believe in:

  • Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy

  • Making electrification upgrades possible

  • Building more resilient homes with reliable backup

  • Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Backend Software Engineer to join our team building the cloud-based glue that gives our users access to the rich information and controls provided by SPAN Panel, SPAN Drive, and future generations of our products. Our system collects a large volume of energy monitoring data that needs to be stored, processed and exposed in different ways for different end users from homeowners to utility operators. We're also opening up never-before available levels of control of the energy in the home that need to be accessed in secure and easy-to-use APIs.

You’ll join our cloud software engineering team and work with other engineers including data engineering, mobile, web, device software (firmware), and systems software teams. Working with the team, you’ll lead the design and implementation of systems that integrate our hardware, mobile apps, dashboards and external APIs. You'll work with product owners and other engineers to build features from start to finish. You'll bring deep infrastructure expertise to bear as a bridge between the Cloud and Platform teams — shaping Kubernetes strategy, networking architecture, and observability standards alongside building product features.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop new features and subsystems in the SPAN Cloud to support a variety of end users from homeowners, installers, fleet and utility partners.

  • Bridge the Cloud and Platform teams on cross-cutting work involving service deployment, reliability, and infrastructure design.

  • Work cross-functionally with product and design teams to learn about our customers, identify solutions and develop the features that solve their needs

  • Collaborate between firmware, frontend and backend engineers on projects to seamlessly build a cohesive product

  • Work in our Kotlin and TypeScript cloud with gRPC, REST APIs and GraphQL as well as communicating with our IoT devices over MQTT.

  • Design APIs and data specifications for internal and external users, including large-scale B2B enterprise clients.

  • Mentor and collaborate with team members, sharing knowledge and best practices to elevate the entire engineering organization

  • Maintain and evolve services over time, including planning for scaling, major version upgrades, and long-term technical debt management

  • Act as the Cloud team's subject matter expert on Kubernetes, service networking, and observability — advising on architecture decisions and standards.

Potential Projects

  • Architect and co-ordinate full-stack solutions to enable new panel functionality such as geolocation-specific demand reduction to assist in reducing peak power draw.

  • Design and build 3rd party cloud-based integrations with a variety of other hardware partners

  • Scale our existing cloud and data infrastructure to support SPAN’s growing fleet

  • Build and maintain event-driven systems using Kafka to process high-volume energy monitoring data

  • Define and drive adoption of Kubernetes networking and observability standards (including service mesh and Datadog integration patterns) across the Cloud engineering team.

  • Integrate payment processing systems including app store payments and subscription billing

About You

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience as a backend engineer with a track record of taking ownership of projects and features.

  • Experience collaborating with engineers from multiple domains to complete projects.

  • Experience with Cloud-native platforms like AWS, GCP, Azure (we use AWS).

  • Experience collaborating with coworkers in shared code base using industry standard tools and processes including version control, type systems, linting and unit testing

  • Understanding engineering principles and processes to design robust, scalable and resilient systems

  • 4+ years of professional experience in a common backend programming language and a desire to work with Kotlin, TypeScript, and Python

  • Strong JVM expertise with deep understanding of JVM internals, performance tuning, and memory management with proven track record of maintaining services over time, including planning for scaling, major version upgrades, and managing technical debt

  • Deep experience with Apache Kafka including topics, consumer groups, stream processing, and event-driven architectures

  • Hands-on Kubernetes experience including debugging workloads, understanding networking (DNS, ingress, service mesh), and advising on deployment architecture.

  • Experience operating observability platforms at scale (Datadog or equivalent) — dashboards, alerting, distributed tracing, and incident response.

Bonus Qualifications

We would love to hire someone with experience working in one or more of the following areas:

  • Internet of Things (IoT) products (e.g. AWS IoT, Google Cloud IoT, something homegrown) or other hardware component A variety of different datastores (e.g. SQL and noSQL, key-value stores, document stores)

  • gRPC or GraphQL APIs.

  • Products with a rich mobile app

  • Infrastructure as code tools like Pulumi or Terraform etc.

  • Familiarity with Data Engineering technologies such as Flink and Spark

  • Experience with service mesh technologies (Istio or equivalent)

  • Spring Boot or Micronaut framework experience

  • App store payments or Stripe billing integration

  • B2B enterprise APIs and partner integrations

  • Experience with tenant isolation patterns (inside a broader multi-tenant architecture)

Life at SPAN

Headquartered in San Francisco’s vibrant SoMa neighborhood, we are an eclectic group of creative thinkers who value open communication, teamwork, and a ‘make it happen’ approach to addressing complex challenges.

SPAN embraces diversity and equal opportunity in a serious way. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

We’re hiring talented individuals who are driven by success and are passionate about shaping the future of renewable energy. If that sounds like you, we’d love for you to consider joining the rapidly growing team at SPAN.

The Perks:

⚡ Competitive compensation + equity grants at a well-funded, venture-backed company

⚡ Comprehensive benefits: 100% employee premiums for base plans on medical, dental, vision with options for additional coverage. Parental leave up to twenty four (24) weeks depending on eligibility

⚡ Comfortable, sunny office space located near BART and Caltrain public transit

⚡ Strong focus on team building and company culture: Employee Resource Groups, monthly social events, SPANcakes recognition breakfast, lunch, and learns

⚡ Flexible hours, one holiday per month, and flexible time off

Interested in joining our team? Apply today and we’ll be in touch with the next steps!

description:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

title: Software Engineer - Java
description:
Software Engineer - Java

Location: Hybrid - Chennai India

Department: Product

Job Title: Software Engineer - Java

Employment Type: Permanent

Work Location: Chennai India - Hybrid


About CloudBees

CloudBees enables enterprises to deliver scalable, compliant, and secure software, empowering developers to do their best work.


Seamlessly integrating into any hybrid and heterogeneous environment, CloudBees is more than a tool—it's a strategic partner in your cloud transformation journey, ensuring security, compliance, and operational efficiency while enhancing the developer experience across your entire software development lifecycle. It allows developers to bring and execute their code anywhere, providing greater flexibility and freedom through fast, self-serve, and secure workflows.


CloudBees supports organizations at every step of their DevSecOps journey, whether using Jenkins on-premise or transitioning software delivery to the cloud. We’re helping customers build the future, today.


About the Role

We use Claude Code every day and are pushing agentic AI further into how we work. If you want to be on a team figuring out what AI-assisted engineering actually looks like on a real, complex product (not a sandbox), this is it.


CDRO (Continuous Delivery & Release Orchestration) is CloudBees' enterprise CD product. It's been running in production at some of the world's largest engineering orgs for over a decade. Hundreds of engineers depend on it to ship software safely and on schedule.


We're a team of about 10, distributed across India, France, Spain, and the US. We're not chasing the next hype cycle feature. We operate a product real customers depend on, modernize it while keeping it stable, and do it with a small team that takes ownership seriously.


Key Responsibilities

Most teams try AI coding tools on greenfield work. We're doing something harder: applying them to a decade-old enterprise codebase with real customers depending on it. CDRO's core is Java 21 with a significant Groovy layer. The work is a mix of internal cleanup that makes the codebase easier to evolve, and direct improvements that make customers' lives better.


Concretely:

  • Own Java work across the core: REST API, pipeline execution engine, persistence layer
  • Continuously reduce complexity: modernize older subsystems, shrink the product surface area where it makes sense, improve test coverage, and leave the codebase easier than you found it
  • Use Claude Code as a normal part of your workflow, to move faster without skipping thought
  • Write tests that prove things work. Shift-left, not "QA will catch it."
  • Document what you build. We're async across timezones. If you know something the team needs to know, write it down.
  • Actively avoid being a single point of failure for anything you own

Qualifications

Required:

  • Solid Java. You've worked professionally at least 4 years developing Java software, in production codebases that weren't yours, in systems that mattered if they broke.
  • Strong AI awareness: you know what Claude Code, or Cursor, etc. do. You've played with some of them at least.
  • Relational database experience: SQL, JPA/Hibernate, schema migrations. Oracle or PostgreSQL background is a strong advantage.
  • Comfort in large, mature codebases. You can navigate unfamiliar code, form a hypothesis, test it, and stay functional when you don't understand everything at once.
  • Testing discipline. You write unit and integration tests as part of the work, not after.
  • Honest communication. If something is blocked or broken, we need to know. We're async and distributed.

Strong plus:

  • Active use of Claude Code to ship real work, not just tab completion. Bonus: you want to push it much further than you do today.
  • Groovy. Willingness to pick it up fast matters more than prior credentials.
  • Kubernetes/Helm: deploying and debugging workloads, not just using them.
  • Experience evolving established systems: migrations, incremental rewrites, dependency upgrades.

Preferred (not mandatory):

  • Jenkins or CI/CD internals
  • Distributed systems infrastructure: message brokers (ActiveMQ, Artemis, RabbitMQ), coordination (Zookeeper)
  • React/TypeScript: the UI is adjacent and not your main domain, but not being afraid of it helps

Who this is for

  • You're a Java engineer who finds large, evolved codebases interesting rather than off-putting. You've seen what breaks when systems are poorly documented and owned by one person. You build the opposite.
  • You want hard engineering problems, real ownership, and a team that says what's true. With ~10 people on the team, you'll touch meaningful parts of the system fast. You'd rather evolve a product real enterprises depend on than build a greenfield service nobody's relying on yet.

Working Conditions

  • Standard working hours: 9:30 a.m. – 6:30 p.m., Mon–Fri, or as per business needs
  • Work location / travel expectations: Hybrid
  • Reasonable accommodations will be considered in line with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

    • Ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive technical work while collaborating effectively with product and engineering teams.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with advanced English proficiency.

      • Experience working in aviation, MRO, ERP, fleet management, or other enterprise operations environments.
      • Familiarity with real-time data processing, streaming architectures, or IoT systems.
      • Knowledge of advanced DevOps practices and experience with data analytics, reporting, or visualization tools.

title: Vulnerability Management Analyst
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Vulnerability Management Analyst to join our information security and data protection team. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with real-world experience in information security and data protection. It's a great opportunity to get hands-on with the tools and processes that keep all our products secure, and to make a genuinely visible difference to how we manage risk day to day.

The Role:

The Vulnerability Management Analyst will help us find, prioritise, and fix security vulnerabilities across our global business and all our products. You’ll configure and tune our vulnerability tools, risk assessing detections, and prioritising findings for fix. You’ll cover code vulnerabilities (SAST, DAST, SCA, OSS licencing), Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Internal Vulnerability Scanning (IVS), and penetration testing. You'll also help design and report on our detection and remediation activities. This is a full-time position. Occasional after-hours work may be required for incident response or urgent security tasks. Successful candidates will be enrolled on a fully funded training pathway and will be provided with mentoring support to help them grow and learn.

Responsibilities:

1. Configuring and tuning our tools

  • Help configure, tune, and maintain our vulnerability tooling across scanning tools, working with platform and engineering teams to keep coverage accurate
  • Support day-to-day scanning schedules and tooling integrations, including ticketing and CI/CD pipelines
  • Look for opportunities to automate reporting, validation, and other repetitive tasks across the whole vulnerability lifecycle

2. Triage and risk assessment

  • Triage findings from vulnerability sources, confirming genuine issues and filtering out false positives
  • Risk-assess confirmed findings against severity, exploitability, and business context, to prioritise fixes
  • Apply a consistent risk-scoring approach so findings are prioritised effectively, regardless of source
  • Stay on top of current threats and trends (e.g. threat actors, new vulnerabilities etc.) to inform vulnerability management activities

3. Designing secure benchmarks and guidelines

  • Develop and maintain secure configuration benchmarks and hardening guidelines for our software, infrastructure, and tooling
  • Align benchmarks and guidelines to recognised industry frameworks for business
  • Work with the right teams to help implement the secure configurations, providing practical advice, and facilitating deviations within our broader risk management framework

4. Working with Developers and Engineers

  • Act as a primary contact point for Developers and Engineers to help them understand and fix issues
  • Track remediation progress, chase owners on overdue items, escalate where necessary
  • Support teams with practical remediation guidance, drawing on the OWASP Top 10, the Mitre Att&ck Framework, and our secure coding standards

5. Coordinating IVS, web application testing, and penetration testing

  • Organise our externally delivered IVS and Penetration Testing programmes, from scheduling and scoping, through to day-to-day contact with our testing partners
  • Help manage our relationships with testing providers, including engagement administration and reporting

6. SLAs, outcome driven metrics, and reporting

  • Help design and report on remediation SLAs across vulnerability classes, severities, and products
  • Produce regular reporting (monthly, quarterly, and ad-hoc) on SLA performance, open findings, and trends
  • Feed data and insight into our wider security metrics and reporting processes

7. Continuous improvement and team support

  • Suggest ways to improve how we manage vulnerabilities and the tools we use to do it
  • Support the rollout of new scanning tools or process changes across our global product estate
  • Help create and maintain our vulnerability management policies, standards, and procedures

Requirements:

  • 2+ years' experience in vulnerability management, security operations, development, or a related security/IT role
  • Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning and management tooling (e.g. SAST, DAST, SCA, CSPM, or IVS)
  • Solid understanding of common vulnerability types and remediation approaches, including familiarity with the Mitre ATT&CK Framework and OWASP Top 10
  • Experience triaging and risk-assessing security findings, helping teams to prioritise remediation based on severity and business impact
  • Comfortable coordinating third-party engagements, such as scheduling and scoping penetration tests
  • Comfortable explaining technical findings to both Developers and non-technical stakeholders
  • Organised enough to manage several scanning programmes, testing engagements, and remediation workstreams in parallel
  • Comfortable working across a global, multi-product environment
  • Comfortable working within an agile enterprise environment
  • Ability to read and understand common coding languages is essential, the ability to write scripts and/or code is preferred
  • Relevant certifications (e.g. CompTIA Security+, CompTIA CySA+, GIAC GFACT/GPEN, or CEH) are preferred but not essential
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with real attention to detail
  • Ability to work autonomously, use good judgement, and know when to escalate

Benefits

Perks at ITG — alongside a competitive salary, here's what you can look forward to:

  • Time off that works for you — 25 days' holiday + bank holidays, a paid Wellbeing Day, flexible bank holidays to honour cultural or religious observances, and the option to buy or carry over up to 5 extra days.
  • Family & life milestones — Enhanced family friendly leave, 3 extra days for your wedding/honeymoon, and an Employee Assistance Programme whenever you need support.
  • Financial perks — Pension scheme, Corporate Medical Cash Plan, electric car salary sacrifice scheme, and tax-efficient payroll giving to your favourite charities.
  • Growth & recognition — Funding for professional qualifications, monthly Employee of the Month awards (£250 bonus), and referral bonuses of up to £1,500.
  • Community & wellbeing — Regular Wellbeing Workshops, 30+ Wellbeing Champions, a paid Volunteer Day, and an online perks platform with discounts on top brands, days out, and gym memberships.

What next? Like what you see? Drop us your application and someone from our team will be in touch.

We Value Diversity

We champion and welcome diversity in our workforce and ensure all job applicants receive equal and fair treatment, regardless of age, race, gender or gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or nationality.

We are not only committed to increasing the visibility and recognition of talent from under-represented groups within our organisation, but the wider industry too.

At the end of the day, we make sure we take time to look after ourselves, each other, and the planet, because we’re always stronger together.

ITG have a number of community groups available to employees and exist to offer a safe space for like-minded colleagues, with shared interests to connect, socialise and check in with each other.

title: Product Cybersecurity Engineer (TARA)
description:
Contract Product Cybersecurity Engineer (TARA)

Location: Hybrid on-site in Surrey for workshops/design sessions
Duration: Initial 3 Months with potential to extend to 6 Months
Rate: TBC based on experience, Outside IR35 status determined by the engaging consultancy)
Right to work: UK right to work without sponsorship required. No security clearance needed.

The Role

A specialist product cybersecurity consultancy is looking for additional delivery capacity on an in-flight EU Cyber Resilience Act conformity programme for a UK manufacturer of specialist commercial vehicles. Five ISO/SAE 21434 threat analysis and risk assessments (TARAs) are in scope across three product lines, including CAN-based vehicle controllers with 4G telematics and a connected fleet-management product on an embedded Linux platform.

The method, templates, governance framework and client relationship are already established and owned by the consultancy's Product Security Architect. This role is delivery capacity within that method not a review, re-baseline or redesign of the approach.

Deliverables

- TARAs to ISO/SAE 21434 for assigned product lines, from item definition and asset identification through damage scenarios, threat scenarios, attack path analysis, attack feasibility rating and risk determination, to a documented risk treatment decision
- Derived, testable and traceable cybersecurity requirements
- Cybersecurity assumptions/interface requirements for third-party platform components
- Contribution to the cybersecurity case for assigned product lines
- Facilitation of technical workshops with client engineering, with written outputs

All work is subject to independent QA before it reaches the client.

Essential Criteria (must be evidenced, not just listed)

- Personally authored at least two completed TARAs to ISO/SAE 21434, item definition through to risk treatment decision and residual risk acceptance, on a product that reached production or formal assessment
- Fluent in the assessment structure: damage scenarios, impact rating, threat scenarios, attack paths, attack feasibility, risk determination, treatment
- Applied a named attack feasibility approach and can justify it over alternatives
- Authored or materially contributed to a cybersecurity case
- Embedded/vehicle systems literacy: ECUs, CAN networks, telematics units, software update paths, embedded Linux
- Derived cybersecurity requirements and passed them to a supplier/integrator, including handling unverifiable third-party platform assumptions
- Facilitated technical workshops with engineers who were not the requesting party
- Assurance-grade written English (documentation that has withstood audit/assessment/regulator scrutiny)

Desirable

- UNECE R155 CSMtGuard, Ansys medini analyze, itemis SECURE, ThreatGet or comparable
- IEC 62443 alongside 21434
- Off-highway, agricultural, construction, municipal or other specialist vehicle sector experience
- Working knowledge of Yocto/emS development, submission or audit exposure
- TARA tooling: Threabedded Linux build systems
- Functional safety experience alongside cybersecurity
- EU Cyber Resilience Act awareness

What this role is NOT

- Not security architecture, Zero Trust or design authority
- Not enterprise, cloud, identity or infrastructure security
- Not CISO, virtual CISO or governance/management-system work
- Not embedded OS implementation (Yocto, kernel config, secure boot, hardening sit with the client's integrator) this role specifies and assures, it does not build

title: Chapter Lead - Mobile
description:
Mobile Chapter Lead​

​

A career with EROAD offers the unique opportunity to work in a fast-growing organisation that is at the forefront of in-vehicle technology, enhancing road safety, productivity, and reducing environmental impact. EROAD's mission is to deliver intelligence you can trust, for a better world tomorrow.​

​

What We're looking for:
​

Are you seeking a technical role that combines people leadership within a dynamic global business? We’re looking for a Mobile Chapter Lead to join our team and help grow and modernize our existing mobile products and engineering processes while leading a team of mobile engineers in Manila.​

​

About the Role:​

As EROAD continues to expand globally, we’re seeking an engineer to develop innovative mobile applications that involve complex problem-solving and building features far beyond simple user interfaces. The role primarily focuses on Native Android development using Java and Kotlin, including Kotlin Multi-Platform (KMP), while also offering exposure to multi-platform technologies such as React Native. Some aspects of the role:​

  • Shapes the strategy and standards for EROAD’s mobile engineering discipline​

  • Coaches and develops mobile engineers across squads, you will be a people leader as well as an engineer​

  • Ensures consistent delivery of high-quality, maintainable, and performant mobile apps​

  • Champions mobile UX, platform integrity, and engineering best practices​

  • Drives collaboration across frontend, backend, and design teams​

  • Embraces AI to increase productivity across the chapter​​

​

Skills and Experience:​

We’re looking for someone with a minimum of 5+ years' experience. You may come from Mobile engineering background and possess skills such as:​

  • Mobile Engineering Expertise: Deep knowledge of mobile platforms and SDKs (Swift, Kotlin, Objective-C, Java) and/or cross-platform solutions (React Native, Flutter, KMP)​

  • Architecture & CI/CD: Experience with mobile architecture, modularisation, mobile CI/CD, and dependency management​

  • People Leadership: Ability to coach, mentor, and manage mobile engineers to grow capability and impact​

  • User-Centered Design: Solid understanding of mobile UX/UI, accessibility, responsiveness, and performance​

  • Security & Compliance: Understanding of secure data storage, encryption, authentication, and platform guidelines​

  • Collaboration: Skilled in stakeholder management, cross-functional alignment, and clear communication​​

Why you’ll love working at EROAD:​

EROAD is a true Kiwi success story in the tech sector! Publicly listed since 2012, we are represented on the NZX and ASX, and continue to grow rapidly across NZ, Australia, and the USA.​
​
At EROAD, we value diversity and are a multicultural company with employees from all over the world. We are committed to investing in our people, demonstrated through our funded medical insurance plans, unlimited sick leave, recognition programs, EAP offerings, and more. EROAD fosters a sense of community and belonging through fun and collaborative workplace initiatives.​
​
In our Albany office, we offer free on-site parking, are in close proximity to Albany bus station, and encourage flexible working. ​

​
Join EROAD and be part of an organisation in growth mode. Your skills and expertise will make a significant impact. We are going places, and we would love you to join us. We can't wait to hear from you!

title: Senior Product Manager - AI
description:
Senior Product Manager, Prolific for AI

Team: Product, Research & Design

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The Role

As we scale our AI Product Group, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take founder-level ownership of the tooling that lets frontier AI model developers conduct cutting-edge research on Prolific. Increasingly, our AI customers are among the leading AI companies in the world, and this role will additionally lead a team of client-facing engineers dedicated to building strategic integrations and rapid, bespoke development for their most demanding needs. You'll report into the AI Lead, and join a brilliant team of Product Managers building next-generation AI tooling within our AI Product Group.

Impact: You'll be the Product person accountable for the outcomes of a stream-aligned team building next-gen tooling for frontier AI model developers, and also prioritise for impact the work of a client-facing engineering team. This is a career-defining moment to shape how some of the world's biggest technology companies build AI – no big deal. You'll own how our most strategic AI clients experience Prolific end to end, from product to bespoke integration.

Experience: You'll bring experience building AI native systems, with particular experience building AI native UX. You'll have had success taking complex human workflows and distilling them into highly adaptable technical systems, then scaling access to those systems across multiple interaction surfaces – UI, APIs, CLIs, and MCPs. You'll also have experience directly managing engineers, ideally in a client-facing or solutions-engineering capacity, and know how to turn a sophisticated client's bespoke needs into a scalable integration rather than a one-off fix.

Domain: You will manage two teams which together give you unmatched closeness and opportunity to build tools for the companies and researchers driving the AI frontier. The Data Collection Tooling team is responsible for building and scaling the systems that enable high-quality human data collection for AI training and evaluation. Additionally the strategic integrations team interfaces directly with our biggest AI accounts for custom builds. It's critical that the person in this role prioritizes both intuitively and systematically, and is a master at the elegant art of trade-offs between the here and now and the future.

Responsibilities: You'll product manage a stream-aligned team of your own, and lead a team of client-facing engineers delivering strategic integrations and rapid, custom development for our most strategic AI accounts. You'll be accountable for the outcomes of both, and be the key driver of interaction with your peer teams, collaborating across domains of science, research, supply, sales, and account services.

Culture: Adding on to our Prolific Principles, we expect colleagues in the Product, Research, and Design Group to demonstrate reliability, grit, diplomacy, a bias for action, and a dogged focus on value – you'll be a champion of these behaviours yourself, and in the culture of your team. Accountability and autonomy are two sides of the same coin, and we expect you to demonstrate both.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and launch the next generation of Prolific's Data Collection Tooling product suite.
  • Lead a team of client-facing engineers delivering strategic integrations and rapid, custom development for our most demanding AI accounts.
  • Stay up to speed with the rapidly changing face of frontier AI research, keeping your product ahead of customer needs.
  • Run the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from strategy to success metrics to roadmap, delivery, and iteration – communicating that strategy clearly to executives while working through the details with your team.
  • Be an unblocker and simplifier of complexity: colleagues will bring you problems, and emerge optimistic, with solutions.
  • Partner productively with Product Design, User Research, Analytics, and Engineering in a test-learn-iterate fashion.

What you'll bring

  • An extensive and varied track record building AI-native products and UX, including scaling access across multiple interaction surfaces such as UI, APIs, CLIs, and MCPs.
  • Experience directly managing engineers, ideally in a client-facing or solutions-engineering capacity, and turning sophisticated clients' bespoke needs into scalable integrations.
  • Fluency in modern Product/Engineering practice: Agile, continuous discovery and delivery, JTBD, vertical slicing, test-learn-iterate.
  • Strong commercial acumen and data-informed decision-making, paired with a storyteller's flair and a relentless can-do attitude.

Even better if you have

  • Experience building for or with frontier AI labs or major technology companies.
  • A track record of giving back to your Product community.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

title: IT Risk Officer
description:
IT Risk Officer

Location: Makati City, NCR, PH

Employment Type: Full time

As an IT Risk Officer, you'll join the Retail Tech IT Risk Team, where you'll play an important role in strengthening ING's technology risk and control environment.

You will partner closely with technology teams to implement and validate IT controls, support risk mitigation activities, and provide guidance on risk standards and best practices. Working with stakeholders across risk, audit, security, and technology functions, you'll help ensure the safety, resilience, and effectiveness of our IT landscape.

This role offers the opportunity to work in an international environment where collaboration, continuous improvement, and learning are part of everyday life.

About the Team

You will become part of ING Hubs Philippines, an international organization supporting ING's Retail and Wholesale Banking businesses worldwide.

The Retail Tech IT Risk Team works closely with technology squads, risk specialists, auditors, and security professionals across multiple locations. Together, we help create a robust control environment that supports innovation while maintaining the highest standards of risk management and compliance.

This is an opportunity to gain exposure to global stakeholders, diverse perspectives, and meaningful work that contributes to the security and stability of banking services used by millions of customers.

What You'll Do

  • Interpret ING's IT risk policies and minimum standards, supporting teams in applying them effectively
  • Implement, maintain, and validate IT controls across systems and processes
  • Perform Test of Design (ToD) and Test of Operational Effectiveness (ToE) activities to assess control effectiveness
  • Advise technology teams on strengthening control environments and operational processes
  • Promote awareness of IT risk topics within the technology community
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across Risk, Audit, Security, and Technology teams
  • Prepare reports, risk assessments, and presentations for management and relevant stakeholders
  • Support Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) activities and continuous improvement initiatives

What We're Looking For

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Accountancy, Business Management, Economics, or a related field
  • At least 3 years of experience in IT Risk Management, IT Audit, or a similar risk-focused role
  • Understanding of IT governance principles and practices
  • Knowledge of Identity and Access Management and Change Management processes
  • Experience supporting risk assessments and control testing activities
  • Understanding of core IT policies, procedures, and controls
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong stakeholder management and reporting capabilities
  • Ability to work effectively with diverse teams in a dynamic, international environment
  • Accountability and ownership in delivering high-quality work

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work with international teams across ING's global network
  • Exposure to risk management practices that support a leading global financial institution
  • A collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued
  • Continuous learning opportunities and professional development
  • The chance to contribute to technology risk initiatives that protect customers and the organization
  • A culture that encourages curiosity, growth, and innovation

Worried about the wage gap? So are we. Our commitment to pay equity means you'll be valued for your skills, not your gender.

How to Apply

Interested in joining us? Click the apply button on our careers site and submit your application through Workday.

Job Application Safety Reminder ⚠️

We're seeing an increase in fraudulent job offers. To protect yourself, please follow these key guidelines when applying for roles at ING:

  • Apply only via official ING platforms. ING uses Workday as its internal recruitment system.
  • Applications should be submitted only through our official careers site.
  • Check the sender's email carefully. Legitimate communication will always come from @ing.com and/or @myworkday.com.
  • ING will never ask for payments or banking details during the recruitment process. If someone requests this information, it is a scam.

About ING

With 65,000 employees and operations in approximately 40 countries, there is no shortage of opportunities for people with initiative who want to help people take a step ahead in life and in business. Do you want to work at the cutting edge of what's possible and at the same time ensure you work with integrity and hold the customer's interests at heart? Do you want to be surrounded by progressive, inspiring, diverse and supportive colleagues? Then there is no better place to invest your talents than at ING. Join us. Apply today.

title: Senior Product Manager aa
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager based in Germany.

As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of a strategic fintech product, from initial discovery and vision through MVP delivery, launch, and continued growth.
You’ll translate customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities into a clear product strategy and actionable roadmap.
Working closely with engineering, design, QA, business stakeholders, customers, and external partners, you’ll lead cross-functional teams toward meaningful outcomes.
The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on product management, including discovery, backlog prioritization, delivery, performance measurement, and optimization.
You’ll have a direct influence on products serving the rapidly evolving financial services ecosystem, with opportunities to work across areas such as payments, KYC/KYB, banking, and SaaS.
The environment is remote-first, collaborative, and fast-paced, giving you significant autonomy while encouraging transparent communication and continuous improvement.
You’ll play a key role in launching and scaling products that solve real customer problems while delivering measurable business value.

Accountabilities

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, objectives, and long-term roadmap for a strategic fintech product.
  • Identify market opportunities, customer needs, and business priorities through customer conversations, user research, competitive analysis, and market insights.
  • Define and validate MVP scope, ensuring a strong balance between customer value, technical feasibility, and business objectives.
  • Own the product lifecycle from discovery and planning through delivery, launch, optimization, and scaling.
  • Build, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer impact, product strategy, and technical feasibility.
  • Define product KPIs and measurable outcomes, monitor performance, and use qualitative and quantitative data to guide product decisions.
  • Lead product discovery through customer interviews, user research, competitor analysis, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Build trusted relationships with customers, enterprise clients, business stakeholders, external partners, and senior leadership.
  • Translate customer feedback and business requirements into actionable product improvements and clearly communicate product direction.
  • Present product strategy, roadmap, progress, and performance to senior stakeholders and leadership.
  • Lead cross-functional teams involving engineering, QA, design, analysts, and other specialists throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with external vendors, technology providers, and third-party integration partners when required.
  • Facilitate product planning sessions, sprint reviews, retrospectives, roadmap discussions, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Ensure clear delivery visibility and transparency using tools such as Jira, Confluence, BigPicture, or comparable product management platforms.
  • Own release readiness and ensure that features meet defined acceptance criteria and deliver meaningful customer and business value.
  • Identify product and delivery risks early, develop mitigation strategies, and coordinate with compliance, regulatory, technical, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Monitor user behavior, feature adoption, activation, conversion, retention, and operational efficiency to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Drive product improvement initiatives based on data, customer feedback, and business performance.
  • Lead the development and launch of an MVP for a strategic KYC-related product, establishing the foundation for future product growth and scaling.

    • Requirements

    • 4+ years of experience as a Product Manager in a product- or technology-driven organization.
    • Proven experience owning products end to end, from discovery and strategy through delivery, launch, and growth.
    • Demonstrated experience working directly with customers, enterprise clients, business stakeholders, and/or senior leadership.
    • Strong experience defining product vision, strategy, roadmaps, MVP scope, and measurable product outcomes.
    • Hands-on experience with Agile product development methodologies and cross-functional delivery teams.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions and translate complex information into clear priorities.
    • Proven experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs according to customer impact, business value, and technical feasibility.
    • Experience collaborating closely with engineering, QA, UI/UX, analytics, and business teams.
    • Practical experience with Jira, Confluence, and other product management or delivery tools.
    • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and leadership skills.
    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment.
    • High level of independence, ownership, and accountability, with the ability to move initiatives forward without extensive oversight.
    • Upper-Intermediate or higher English proficiency.
    • Experience building products from scratch or taking products through a 0-to-1 journey is an advantage.
    • Experience launching MVPs and subsequently scaling products is a plus.
    • Fintech experience in areas such as payments, PSP, EMI, acquiring, open banking, KYC/KYB, compliance, card issuing, digital wallets, banking, lending, or SaaS is highly valued.
    • Experience with third-party integrations, external technology providers, or vendor management is beneficial.
    • Experience leading distributed or remote teams is an advantage.
    • Product management certifications such as PSPO, Scrum Product Owner, Agile, or similar are a plus.

      • Benefits

      • Competitive compensation package based on experience.
      • 19 business days of flexible paid time off.
      • Fully remote working arrangement.
      • Flexible working hours aligned with the Central European Time (CET) zone.
      • Ability to work remotely from a location of your choice within the supported regions.
      • Friendly, supportive, and values-driven working environment.
      • Opportunities to attend and contribute to industry conferences and professional community events.
      • Matrix organizational structure designed to support efficient communication, collaboration, and decision-making.
      • Opportunity to develop your product management expertise within a fast-moving fintech environment.
      • Direct ownership and meaningful impact on strategic products serving the financial services ecosystem.

Työnkuvasi ja vastuualueesi

Tule mukaan rakentamaan älykkäämpää tulevaisuutta! Aluemyyntipäällikkönä työskentelet tuotteiden parissa, joilla on vaikutus energiatehokkuuteen ja kestävään kehitykseen.

Aluemyyntipäällikkö toimii ABB Oy:n kotimaan myynnissä Smart Buildings ja Smart Power -divisioonissa. Pääset yhdistämään teknisen osaamisesi asiakastyöhön, sillä työskentelet pienjännitekomponenttien parissa ja asiakkuuksiisi kuuluvat nimetyt kojeistorakentajat ja OEM-asiaakkuudet. Lisäksi teet läheistä yhteistyötä ABB:n sähkötukkukanavan teollisuusmyynnin kanssa.

  • Erinomaiset viestintä- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky rakentaa asiakassuhteita eri sidosryhmien kanssa

ABB Smart Buildings mahdollistaa energiatehokkuuden, turvallisuuden, suojan ja mukavuuden optimoinnin kaikentyyppisissä rakennuksissa uusien asennusten tai jälkiasennusratkaisujen avulla. Divisioonan erittäin innovatiiviset teknologiat ja digitaaliset ratkaisut vastaavat kasvavaan maailmanlaajuiseen kysyntään kiinteistökehittäjien, omistajien ja sijoittajien keskuudessa älykkäiden rakennusteknologioiden osalta, jotka optimoivat energianjakelun ja rakennusautomaation. ABB Smart Power on teknologian maailmanjohtaja, jonka tuotteet ja ratkaisut suojaavat virtalähteitä ja tuovat niihin tiedonsiirtoyhteyden ja älytoimintoja. ABB Smart Powerin älykkäät tuotteet ja ratkaisut parantavat kilpailukykyä parantamalla lähes minkä tahansa toimintojen energiatehokkuutta, tuottavuutta ja luotettavuutta.


Kulttuurimme ja etumme heijastavat arvojamme: rohkeus, välittäminen, uteliaisuus ja yhteistyö. Henkilöstömme arvostaa eduistamme tällä hetkellä eniten esimerkiksi vuosibonusta, mahdollisuutta osallistua osakkeenomistusohjelmaan, jatkuvia oppimismahdollisuuksia ja hyvinvointi- ja perhe-etuja.

title: Founding GTM & Operations Lead
description:
AgentMail is building the identity and communication infrastructure for AI agents, starting with email. We're a category-defining company and are looking for a Founding GTM & Operations Lead to design and run our growth playbook across all channels.

This role is critical to our function and owns how AgentMail grows. You will build the systems, narrative, and execution that turn early momentum into repeatable, compounding growth. Behind the growth, you'll also set up scalable automations and operating processes, tighten internal workflows, drive pricing and logistics projects, and build the dashboards we use to make decisions.

AgentMail has raised $6M from investors including General Catalyst, Y Combinator, Paul Graham (founder of YC), Karim Atiyeh (founder of Ramp), Paul Copplestone (founder of Supabase), and Dharmesh Shah (founder of HubSpot).

What you'll work on

  • Build and own the GTM playbook across all channels including PLG, content, community, outbound, partnerships, events, and launches

  • Design and run growth experiments end to end, then scale what compounds

  • Turn product usage and market signal into repeatable distribution loops

  • Define category narrative, positioning, and messaging so AgentMail becomes the default answer

  • Partner with product and engineering to bake growth into the product

  • Create repeatable launch motions for features, use cases, and integrations

  • Capture data across sales, product, and ops to build the dashboards that drive decisions

  • Build automations, internal tools, templates, and workflows that scale

  • Drive initiatives in pricing, logistics, vendor management, and ops quality

  • Define and test early sales motions with tight feedback loops, and run cross functional projects with fast turnaround

You're a fit if

  • You think in systems and growth loops, not one-off campaigns

  • You enjoy building playbooks from zero and pressure-testing them

  • You can run GTM across channels with high ownership

  • You are technical enough to build automations and develop a deep understanding of our product

  • You're Type A, process minded, and love making systems cleaner and faster

  • You can turn messy problems into crisp plans

  • You care about category creation, not just funnel optimization, and you want real ownership over how a company grows

Bonus points

  • Experience growing developer tools, infrastructure, or API-first products

  • Familiarity with PLG and sales-assisted growth

  • Strong intuition for content, community, and distribution

  • Experience with GTM systems and softwares: Zapier or similar automation tools (Make, n8n), Airtable, Notion, Google Sheets, CRM systems like HubSpot, basic dashboard tools, and comfort working with simple API style data like JSON

Previous operating, consulting, and investment banking experience is a plus.

Compensation: $110K to $175K, plus 0.2% to 0.5% equity.

PS. our bar for this position is ridiculously high. We are aiming to build one of the most distributed products of all time. If selected for an interview, expect growth discussions and case studies as part of our process.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - APAC
description:
About the Company

The OpenAI Deployment Company ("DeployCo") is the deployment arm of OpenAI, purpose-built to deliver enterprise AI transformation at scale. As model capabilities accelerate, deployment has become the primary constraint to realizing AI value creation within large enterprises. DeployCo bridges that gap.

Our ambition is to build the company that defines AI deployment. We operate at the intersection of cutting-edge AI, enterprise transformation, and scaled services delivery. We partner with enterprise customers to identify where AI can transform their businesses and build solutions leveraging OpenAI's models and products. We work with many of the world's largest and most influential companies to solve their most complex business challenges using the latest advances in AI.

People who thrive at DeployCo get excited about ambitious and complex work. We are deep believers in the future with AI. We execute quickly, value intellectual honesty and empathy, and obsess over the solutions we build for our customers.

DeployCo is being built from the ground up as a subsidiary of OpenAI and funded with a partnership of outside investors.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Applied AI Software Engineer to lead the design, build, and deployment of enterprise AI systems. In this role, you will operate as a senior technical owner across customer engagements, shaping architecture, setting engineering standards, and helping teams move from prototypes to durable production AI systems. DeployCo is one of the few places where engineers can work with the autonomy of a small startup while building for the scale, complexity, and impact of the world’s largest enterprises.

Your day-to-day will include leading technical discovery, designing solution architecture, building production-grade agentic AI applications, mentoring engineers, evaluating model behavior, and translating field learning into reusable platform and delivery patterns. We typically use existing closed- and open-source foundation models, including OpenAI models and APIs, and focus on turning state-of-the-art capabilities into reliable products.

We're looking for engineers who deploy high-quality agentic systems into real customer workflows and business critical decisions and deliver reusable components that help future deployments move faster.

This role is based in Singapore, with hybrid work and customer travel shaped by deployment needs.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead software engineering workstreams for customer deployments, owning architecture, implementation quality, evaluation strategy, and production readiness for LLM-powered systems.

  • Build AI applications, agents, and workflow tools using LLMs, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, data systems, and production software practices.

  • Guide engineers through ambiguous technical problems, reviewing designs, code, tradeoffs, and operating assumptions.

  • Work directly with customer technical teams and business stakeholders to translate workflows into reliable AI systems.

  • Prototype quickly, identify what is reusable, and harden successful patterns into reference architectures and implementation assets.

  • Design evaluation and monitoring approaches that improve quality, reliability, safety, and customer trust.

  • Surface field insights to Product and Research, connecting deployment reality to roadmap priorities and model/system improvements.

You may thrive in this role if you:

  • Bring senior software engineering experience building production applications and microservices, including APIs, scalable data pipelines, data systems, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Use your expertise in Python and SQL to design and build robust data applications in enterprise environments.

  • Bring production LLM experience, including leading teams delivering generative AI systems with hands-on understanding in agents, retrieval, evaluation, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and model integration.

  • Have led software engineering projects from prototype to production and can set a high-quality bar while keeping teams moving quickly.

  • Are comfortable as a hands-on player-coach: writing code, reviewing designs, mentoring engineers, and owning customer outcomes.

  • Communicate clearly with executive, product, research, customer, and engineering audiences when decisions involve risk or ambiguity.

  • Make disciplined standardization-versus-customization decisions instead of defaulting to bespoke work.

  • Operate calmly under pressure and turn messy deployment problems into practical, reusable engineering patterns.

title: Electrical Monitoring Engineer
description:
Electrical Monitoring Engineer

Location: Greenville, Barcelona

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Job Description Summary

The engineer in this role will serve as a Lead Electrical Monitoring Engineer on the
Electrical, Controls, and Operability (EC&O) Monitoring Team. The engineer in this
role will execute proactive electrical monitoring and diagnostic assessments across the fleet, with focus on detecting emerging risks early and converting data into clear, actionable recommendations.

The engineer in this role will support the team mission to detect, diagnose, and
communicate abnormal electrical, controls, and system-level behavior before issues become outages, repeat events, or sustained performance losses.

Job Description

Role Scope

The engineer in this role will develop and execute electrical monitoring methods and diagnostic assessments for high-impact electrical issues, including fire prevention, converter faults, generator performance anomalies, transformer and protection events, nuisance electrical trips, and instability patterns. The engineer in this role will work closely with more senior members on the team and cross-functional partners in Services, Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Systems Engineering, Fleet Reliability, Root Cause Analysis, and Fleet Performance teams.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Execute proactive monitoring of electrical system health using SCADA, alarms, events, operational history, and field data.
  • Develop and improve electrical condition indicators, thresholds, and detection logic for identified failure and degradation modes.
  • Perform deep diagnostic assessments for recurring electrical issues, intermittent faults, nuisance trips, and instability patterns.
  • Distinguish actionable electrical risk from expected operational variation and non-critical anomalies.
  • Translate diagnostic findings into practical recommendations, including troubleshooting direction and maintenance priorities.
  • Partner with more senior members on the team to align diagnostic priorities, escalation decisions, and action recommendations.
  • Support standardization of electrical monitoring documentation, issue classification, and technical communication quality.
  • Build technical depth in electrical monitoring by applying feedback, sharing lessons learned, and supporting continuous improvement of team methods.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline.
  • 4+ years of relevant engineering experience in wind, power generation, industrial controls, or rotating equipment diagnostics.
  • Strong understanding of turbine electrical systems, including converters, generators, transformers, protection concepts, and balance-of-plant interfaces.
  • Demonstrated experience diagnosing electrical performance issues from operational data and event history.
  • Strong data literacy with hands-on use of SCADA trends, event logs, and alarm data in technical decision-making.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly to engineering and operations stakeholders.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience supporting fleet-level reliability programs and corrective action campaigns.
  • Experience with scripting or analytics tools such as Python, SQL, or equivalent for data-driven diagnostics.
  • Familiarity with root cause analysis workflows and reliability-centered maintenance concepts.
  • Experience building or improving alert logic, dashboards, and fleet triage workflows.
  • Experience with SCADA visualization and data-driven decision-making in operational settings.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We’re looking for people to join the Access family, who share our passion for believing in better, and who will help us continue to grow.

Love Work. Love Life. Be You. - is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them.

What does Access offer you?

We offer a blended approach to office working, encouraging you to collaborate and connect in one of our thriving offices. We deliver on what we say, taking the development of our people seriously. We’ll work with you to progress your success plan and provide opportunities to accelerate your career.

On top of a competitive salary, our wellbeing days taking you to 25 days leave a year and a health contribution, you’ll also be able to choose from a range of benefits to suit you. We’re an organisation that likes to give back, so you’ll also have three charity days allocated to support a cause that matters to you.

About you

You are a data engineer at heart, with strong software engineering foundations. You enjoy building scalable data platforms and take ownership of the reliability, performance, and quality of what you create.

You care about data – not just how it moves, but how it is protected, governed and trusted. You’re confident working across teams, and you use modern tools (including AI) to improve the speed and quality of your work.

Day-to-day, you will:

  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines and models that bring together data from across multiple products into one trusted platform
  • Own the performance, cost and reliability of your pipelines in production, ensuring they meet agreed service levels
  • Work closely with product teams to deliver clean, well-structured data that can be used for reporting, analytics and AI features
  • Protect and manage data responsibly, ensuring strong data quality, governance, and compliance with regulations such as GDPR

Your skills and experiences might also include:

  • Experience with Python and SQL, plus exposure to platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks or similar
  • Knowledge of cloud environments like Azure or AWS and data pipeline orchestration tools
  • Understanding of data security, including handling sensitive data (such as personal or payment information)
  • Familiarity with modern development practices such as CI/CD and using AI tools to improve development workflows

What are we all about?

The Access Group is one of the largest UK-headquartered business management software providers. It provides solutions that empower more than 160,000 small and mid-sized organisations in commercial and non-profit sectors across Europe, USA and APAC, giving every employee the freedom to do more of what's important. Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used.

With over 9,300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence, we’re shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access, people are at the heart of everything we do. We’re committed to creating an inclusive, high-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you’re excited about this role - even if your experience doesn’t tick every box - you might be exactly who we’re looking for.

We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?

Let’s make a difference together.

Love Work. Love Life. Be You.

title: Technical Execution Manager, Hydro Turbine Mechanical Design
description:
Gestionnaire de l’exécution technique – Conception mécanique Turbine hydraulique / Technical Execution Manager – Hydro Turbine Mechanical design

Location: Brossard

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Job Description Summary

Le ou la gestionnaire de l’exécution technique – Turbine hydraulique est responsable du pilotage technique de projets de turbines hydrauliques, de la reprise du contrat jusqu’au soutien à l’installation et à la mise en service. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de gestion de projet, de chantier ainsi qu’avec les clients et partenaires externes, cette personne assure l’alignement des exigences techniques, des interfaces et des livrables afin de contribuer à la réussite globale du projet.
Ce rôle s’adresse à un(e) ingénieur(e) mécanique d’expérience qui aime prendre en charge des projets complexes, gérer plusieurs parties prenantes et contribuer à des projets d’envergure pour des clients majeurs du secteur de l’énergie. Dans le domaine hydroélectrique, un projet typique s’échelonne sur environ trois ans et mobilise en moyenne une équipe de 15 à 20 ingénieurs et dessinateurs pendant les phases de conception.
/
Role Summary
The Technical Execution Manager – Hydro Turbine is responsible for leading the technical execution of hydro turbine projects from contract handover through installation and commissioning support. Working closely with engineering, project management, site teams, customers, and external partners, this role ensures alignment of technical requirements, interfaces, and deliverables to support overall project success.
This role is well suited for an experienced mechanical engineer who enjoys taking ownership of complex projects, managing multiple stakeholders, and contributing to major energy projects for leading customers in the sector. In the hydroelectric industry, a typical project lasts approximately three years and involves a design team of 15 to 20 engineers and drafters during the design phases.

Job Description

Principales responsabilités

  • Piloter l’exécution technique des projets turbines en assurant l’alignement entre l’ingénierie, la gestion de projet, le chantier et les parties prenantes externes.
  • Analyser les exigences contractuelles, les interfaces techniques et les hypothèses de portée avec les clients, partenaires et équipes internes.
  • Diriger les réunions de suivi technique, soutenir la prise de décision et assurer le suivi des actions et des enjeux.
  • Suivre les livrables d’ingénierie et les priorités techniques en fonction des objectifs de qualité, d’échéancier, de coût et de risque.
  • Soutenir les activités d’installation et de mise en service en coordonnant les réponses techniques aux enjeux relevés sur le site ou par les clients.
  • Gérer la documentation technique, les mandats de conception et les communications externes liés à la portée turbine.

Qualifications requises

  • Baccalauréat en génie mécanique.
  • 7 à 10 ans d’expérience pertinente en ingénierie, en exécution de projets ou en gestion technique.
  • Expérience dans la gestion d’interfaces avec des clients et des parties prenantes externes.
  • Solides compétences en gestion de priorités, en communication et en coordination de projet.
  • Bilingue français/anglais - aptitudes pour rédaction requises: GE Vernova fournit des services de haute qualité à des clients situés à travers le monde et l'employé doit être capable de fournir des services d'une manière efficace alignée sur les normes d'excellence de l'entreprise
  • Membre de l’OIQ.
  • Expérience dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et matriciel.

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Expérience dans l’hydroélectricité, l’industrie lourde, les machines tournantes ou la conception de turbines.
  • Expérience en gestion de projet d’ingénierie ou dans un environnement d’exécution de projet.
  • Certification en gestion de projet ou expérience équivalente.
  • Esprit proactif, capacité d’analyse et aptitude à influencer dans un environnement collaboratif.

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous

Ce poste offre l’occasion de contribuer à des projets majeurs de turbines hydrauliques pour des clients de premier plan du secteur de l’énergie. Vous travaillerez avec des équipes talentueuses en ingénierie, en exécution de projet, sur site et auprès de clients et partenaires externes, dans un environnement stimulant où votre contribution aura un impact concret.

GE Vernova

GE Vernova Hydro est un chef de file reconnu en hydroélectricité, contribuant à fournir une énergie fiable et renouvelable partout au Canada et dans le monde. L’hydroélectricité joue un rôle essentiel dans la construction d’un système énergétique plus propre et plus résilient, et nos équipes sont au cœur de projets majeurs de modernisation et de nouvelles installations, y compris des solutions de stockage par pompage de pointe. Joignez-vous à nous et contribuez à façonner l’avenir de l’hydroélectricité grâce à l’innovation, la collaboration et un travail porteur de sens.

/

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical execution of turbine projects, ensuring alignment between engineering, project management, site teams, and external stakeholders.
  • Review contract requirements, technical interfaces, and scope assumptions with customers, partners, and internal teams.
  • Drive technical follow-up meetings, support decision-making, and track actions and open issues through closure.
  • Monitor engineering deliverables and technical priorities against quality, schedule, cost, and risk objectives.
  • Support installation and commissioning activities by coordinating technical responses to site and customer issues.
  • Manage technical documentation, design packages, and external communications related to turbine scope.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in engineering, project execution, or technical management.
  • Experience managing interfaces with customers and external stakeholders.
  • Strong project coordination, prioritization, and communication skills.
  • Bilingualism (French and English) – writing aptitude required. GE Vernova supplies high quality services to its client worldwide and the employee must be able to provide efficient services aligned with the company excellence standards.
  • Membership in the OIQ.
  • Experience working in a multidisciplinary, matrixed environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in hydroelectric power, heavy industry, rotating machinery, or turbine design.
  • Experience in engineering project management or project execution environments.
  • Project management certification or equivalent experience.
  • Proactive mindset, strong analytical skills, and ability to influence in a collaborative environment.

Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to major hydro turbine projects for leading customers in the energy sector. You will work with talented teams across engineering, project execution, site, and external customer organizations in a dynamic environment where your contribution has a real impact.

GE Vernova

GE Vernova’s Hydro business is a trusted leader in hydroelectric power, helping deliver reliable, renewable energy across Canada and around the world. Hydropower plays a vital role in building a cleaner, more resilient energy system, and our teams are at the center of major modernization and new-build projects, including advanced pumped storage solutions. Join us and help shape the future of hydroelectric power through innovation, collaboration, and meaningful work.

Overview

As a Signal and Power Integrity Engineer, you will play a vital role in advancing next-generation consumer hardware systems. You will contribute to the Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SIPI) design efforts, ensuring high performance and reliability through comprehensive system and board simulation and validation. This role demands a highly independent yet collaborative engineer who can work seamlessly with EE designers, system validation engineers, and vendors, driving design quality and aligning hardware specifications with system requirements.

  • Develop scripts to enhance workflows and automate tools for SIPI processes.

  • Proficient in signal and power integrity principles, and knowledgeable about PCB and flex design and manufacturing processes.
  • Demonstrated expertise in impedance control, transmission line concepts, and the development of practical design guidelines.
  • Experience developing workflows and test methodologies for signal integrity validation.
  • Hands-on experience with high-speed lab equipment and PHY compliance test setups.
  • Strong organizational skills, with attention to detail and thorough documentation abilities.
  • Familiarity with CAD tools, constraint management,
  • Familiarity with high-speed interface protocols (e.g., PSRAMs, Flash, MIPI).

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Air & Missile Defense Radar team develops cutting-edge tracking algorithms and software systems that detect, track, and characterize airborne threats in real-time. Working in small, focused teams, our software engineers design and implement sophisticated tracking solutions that protect lives and critical assets. Our work spans the full spectrum—from developing novel multi-target tracking algorithms to building high-performance distributed systems that process massive amounts of sensor data in milliseconds

If you're passionate about applying mathematics, software engineering, and signal processing to solve complex real-world problems, we want to hear from you.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build and leverage modeling & simulation environments to validate tracking performance, quantify system capabilities, and identify areas for improvement

  • Solid foundation in mathematics: linear algebra, probability, statistics, and/or differential equations
  • Understanding of software engineering fundamentals: design patterns, testing, version control, and debugging
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret SCI security clearance

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with tracking, estimation, or filtering algorithms (Kalman filters, particle filters, multiple hypothesis tracking, etc.)

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. Job Description

Intro

The DealerOps team at Cox Automotive is leading the modernization of the dealer management system experience — reimagining how dealerships run their financial operations on a cloud-native platform built for the way dealers work today. This is foundational platform work, and the accounting domain sits at the center of it.


As a Senior Product Manager for DMS Accounting, you will drive discovery, delivery, and continuous improvement across core accounting workflows — including GL management, deal posting, cash receipts, and period close — that dealership controllers and accounting teams rely on every day. You'll bring together dealer feedback, engineering collaboration, and data-informed judgment to ship product that meaningfully improves how dealerships operate their back office, while contributing to a broader modernization effort that is redefining the DMS category at Cox.


What You'll Do

  • Own a defined set of DMS Accounting workflows end-to-end, from discovery through delivery, ensuring features are well-scoped, prioritized, and shipped with quality.
  • Conduct dealer research and site visits on a recurring cadence, building relationships with accounting staff and controllers to surface friction, validate assumptions, and translate insights into product decisions.
  • Create and maintain well-structured backlogs across Epic, Feature, and Story altitudes, partnering with engineering to refine scope, resolve dependencies, and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners in Engineering, Architecture, UX, and Go-to-Market to ensure product releases are well-executed and dealer-ready.
  • Use product metrics, usage data, and qualitative feedback to evaluate in-market performance and make evidence-based recommendations for iteration and investment.
  • Contribute to investment cases and roadmap inputs that connect accounting workflow improvements to measurable dealer and business outcomes.
  • Develop a working knowledge of the competitive DMS landscape and evolving dealer expectations in accounting operations, keeping the team informed and the product strategy grounded.

Who You Are

Minimum

Cox Automotive uses a capabilities framework to define how our product practitioners operate. Candidates for this role are expected to demonstrate working proficiency across its six practice areas.

  • For Market & Client Research, you participate in dealer site visits and interviews, synthesize research findings into structured discovery artifacts, and can identify and articulate problems and opportunities within an established product domain.
  • For Product Strategy, you contribute to product vision and roadmap development with guidance from product leadership, and can support solution discovery and prioritization decisions with data and customer input.
  • For Product Development, you create and maintain product backlogs at the Epic, Feature, and Story level with clear scope and acceptance criteria, facilitate refinement sessions, and deliver complete, high-quality release notes and launch inputs.
  • For In-Market Product Performance Management, you track and interpret product metrics to inform decisions and can contribute to product lifecycle assessments with support from senior team members.
  • For Professional Essentials, you communicate clearly across engineering, design, and business stakeholders, adapt your communication style to your audience, and take accountability for your product area's outcomes.
  • For Technology Savvy, you engage productively in technical conversations with engineering partners, understand basic architectural constraints, and can represent user and business needs in a technical context.

Additionally, you have 3 or more years of product management experience owning features or workflows within a B2B or enterprise software product, and experience working in Agile or SAFe delivery environments using tools such as Rally or Jira.


Preferred


Domain & Industry Experience

  • Familiarity with dealership operations, automotive retail workflows, or DMS software (CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion, or equivalent).

  • Demonstrated familiarity with AI-Native Product Building — the ability to identify where AI can meaningfully improve a product workflow and contribute to defining what responsible, high-value AI integration looks like in practice.
