title: Critical Operations Director (Australia)
description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

STACK is seeking an experienced Critical Operations Director to establish and lead the Operations function for its Melbourne data centre campus. Reporting to the VP Critical Operations (Aust), this role has end-to-end accountability for site safety, operational readiness, reliability, customer service and the performance of all mission-critical mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire life safety, controls and base-building systems.

This is a senior people leadership role for a proven leader who has successfully managed 100+ employees, including managers, supervisors and frontline technical teams. The Director will recruit, develop and lead the Operations team, work collaboratively across STACK, build trusted customer relationships and create an inclusive, accountable and high-performing culture. All Critical Operations staff report through this role.

Candidates may come from data centres or other complex mission-critical environments, including Defence, naval operations, aviation, utilities, power generation, transport, healthcare or large-scale industrial operations. Direct data-centre experience is advantageous but is not essential where the candidate can demonstrate leadership of large technical workforces, operational readiness, asset reliability and incident command in a high-consequence 24/7 environment.

This role directly supports STACK’s commitment to 100% uptime and a concierge-level customer service experience, ensuring risk is proactively managed, planned works are executed safely, and customer communications are clear, timely and professional.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

People Leadership and Team Performance

• Provide visible, accountable and people-centred leadership for an operational workforce of 100+ employees across multiple shifts, technical disciplines and leadership levels.

• Lead through managers and supervisors while remaining connected to frontline teams, setting clear priorities, modelling STACK values, ensuring consistent standards and maintaining effective escalation across every shift.

• Build the campus Operations team from day one, owning workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, retention, succession planning and development as the site ramps into full operation.

• Set and actively manage performance expectations through regular leadership meetings, 1:1 sessions, coaching and talent reviews; ensure employees are trained and competent; recognise strong performance; and address performance issues promptly and consistently.

• Create an inclusive, accountable and high-performing culture in which leaders collaborate, employees are empowered to make sound decisions and teams remain aligned to customer and operational priorities.

Operational Leadership and Reliability

• Lead a standardised culture of always working safely and take full accountability for the readiness, uptime, reliability and day-to-day operation of the campus.

• Provide credible technical leadership across mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems, fire life safety, controls and other mission-critical infrastructure.

• Ensure preventive and predictive maintenance programs, technical procedures and critical work packages are executed safely through robust change management, protecting live operations during construction and commissioning.

• Lead critical operational decisions and the response to abnormal conditions, incidents and emergencies, including customer communications, root-cause analysis and corrective action tracking.

• Manage site systems, capacity and efficiency using CMMS, EPMS and BMS to avoid customer-impacting outages and support informed operational decisions.

Collaboration, Customer Service and Commercial Management

• Work collaboratively with the VP Critical Operations (Aust) and across Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Security, Commercial, Customer, Finance and Procurement to deliver coordinated outcomes for the campus.

• Build trusted relationships with customers and act as the senior operational leader for the campus, providing clear, timely and professional communication on inquiries, planned work, incidents, risks and service performance.

• Champion STACK’s concierge-level customer service, ensure the team understands customer contracts and SLAs, and resolve escalations with empathy, sound judgement and a solutions-focused approach.

• Maintain clear, timely and professional customer communication before, during and after planned works, incidents and service-impacting events.

• Manage vendor performance, service contracts, procurement, billing and compliance with agreed KPIs and SLAs.

• Develop and manage site CAPEX and OPEX budgets, balancing reliability, safety, customer commitments and total cost of ownership.

• Drive operational excellence through proactive planning, risk management, continuous improvement, site projects, reporting, audits and compliance activities; advise the VP Critical Operations (Aust) on performance, risks and priorities.

• Maintain on-call availability and provide senior leadership during emergency situations or significant operational events.

Competencies

• Proven senior people-management experience leading 100+ employees, including managers, supervisors and frontline technical staff in a complex 24/7 environment.

• Proven ability to recruit, build, inspire and develop high-performing technical teams, with strong coaching, succession planning and performance-management capability.

• Highly collaborative leadership style, with demonstrated success partnering across Operations, Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Security, Commercial, Customer, Finance and Procurement to deliver coordinated outcomes.

• Customer-focused leader with demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships, manage expectations, resolve escalations and deliver clear, timely and professional service.

• Sufficient technical credibility to lead and challenge senior mechanical, electrical, controls, fire and facilities specialists. The successful candidate does not need to be the subject-matter expert in every discipline but must demonstrate sound technical judgement, disciplined risk management and the ability to make informed operational decisions.

Work Environment

• Based on-site at Truganina Campus, Melbourne, with travel, on-call availability and work outside standard hours as required.

Required Education and Experience

• Extensive experience leading operations within a live data centre, Defence environment or other high-consequence mission-critical operation, with accountability for a workforce of 100+ employees, operational readiness, safety, asset reliability and emergency response.

• Proven record of recruiting, coaching, developing and retaining managers, supervisors and frontline technical teams, including succession planning and consistent performance management.

• Demonstrated success working collaboratively across functions and influencing senior stakeholders to deliver coordinated operational outcomes.

• Demonstrated customer-service leadership, including building trusted relationships and communicating clearly during planned works, incidents and service escalations.

• Demonstrated experience managing maintenance, vendors, complex projects, customers and significant site budgets, with strong knowledge of service-level obligations, regulatory compliance and relevant building-code requirements. Direct experience with data centre SLAs is advantageous but not essential.

Preferred Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent military, operational or professional experience.

• Senior command, engineering, sustainment or operational leadership experience within the Australian Defence Force or an allied Defence organisation will be highly regarded.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

• Willingness to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, public holidays and on-call support, in a high-pressure environment.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

• Full Australian working rights and ability to pass background checks and attain and maintain NV1 security clearance where required.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, redundancy, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this role. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) – Web Rendering Engineer
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the rendering infrastructure behind a novel search engine designed for agentic AI. In this role, you will design systems that transform modern web applications into high quality structured content for search and AI. You will work on browser rendering, JavaScript execution, and large-scale rendering infrastructure capable of processing billions of pages efficiently. Modern websites increasingly rely on client-side rendering, dynamic data loading, and complex application frameworks. Your work will ensure we can reliably render, understand, and extract valuable information while minimising cost and latency.

In this position, your responsibility will be to:

  • Design and build large-scale rendering systems for modern web applications
  • Develop browser-based rendering infrastructure capable of executing complex JavaScript applications reliably
  • Research how modern frontend frameworks render and deliver content
  • Improve rendering quality, completeness, and performance across diverse websites
  • Optimise rendering cost, latency, resource utilisation, and throughput at internet scale
  • Translate rendering research into reliable production systems

You may be a good fit if you:

Have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working on production backend or infrastructure systems and are an expert in several of the following areas:

  • Browser Rendering
  • Chromium rendering pipeline — DOM, Layout, Paint, and Compositing
  • JavaScript execution inside browsers and rendering lifecycle and page readiness
  • Headless browser execution and browser instrumentation
  • Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)
  • Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or similar frameworks Modern Web Applications
  • React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, and modern frontend architectures
  • Server-side rendering (SSR), client-side rendering (CSR), and streaming rendering
  • Single-page applications (SPA) and Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
  • Resource loading, lazy loading, and modern JavaScript bundles

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

  • Building and operating high-throughput content processing pipelines at internet scale
  • Distributed systems design and performance optimisation
  • Open-source contributions or active involvement in the engineering community
  • Conference talks or technical publications

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Machine Learning Engineer

About the Company

Cartesian is building spatial intelligence for indoor environments to drive operational efficiency.

We're tackling one of the biggest challenges in the $35T global retail industry: in-store inventory visibility. Our platform delivers accurate indoor positioning and actionable product location insights, helping retailers streamline operations, optimize workflows, and reduce inefficiencies. By fusing wireless signals and mobile computer vision, we provide a uniquely scalable and infrastructure-free solution already deployed by international fashion brands.

Founded by an MIT engineering professor and alum behind the award-winning, patented core technologies, Cartesian spun out in 2023. Originally backed by the prestigious SBIR Award from the US National Science Foundation, we've bootstrapped to a live product that's now deployed in over a dozen countries and have been aggressively scaling in the market.

About the Role

We're looking for a highly motivated, product-oriented Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our core R&D team at a pivotal moment in our growth. You'll own ML problems end to end, from framing and data, through modeling and evaluation, to production and monitoring across hundreds of live stores, and help shape the technical roadmap of a category-defining product. We move fast, care deeply about quality, and value people who take initiative and crave real-world impact.

Because our challenges span wireless signals, time series, spatial reasoning, research and production, success in this role requires a unique balance: the breadth to connect the dots across diverse domains, and the depth of judgment to evaluate trade-offs rigorously, dig into the details when models fail, and confidently drive solutions to production; we want an adaptable engineer who can navigate ambiguity with high technical standards.

You'll be joining us in-person in the heart of Kendall Square, Cambridge, next to MIT and the Charles River.

Responsibilities
  • Work closely with applied scientists to design, develop, deploy, and monitor deep learning and ML models for indoor positioning and item localization, owning problems end-to-end.
  • Build and improve the training, inference, and evaluation pipelines that take models from prototype to production.
  • Optimize models and systems for accuracy, coverage, latency, and cost, and own the trade-offs between them.
  • Develop tools and datasets to benchmark performance in real-world, at-scale settings.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to prioritize what's worth building and to ship features to enterprise customers.
  • Raise the team's engineering bar through reusable infrastructure, better design patterns, and honest technical judgment on architecture and technology choices.
Qualifications
  • BSc/MSc in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field with 5+ years of applied ML experience, with at least one system taken personally from ambiguous problem to shipped, measured impact.
  • Broad, hands-on command of machine learning (e.g. supervised and unsupervised learning, embeddings and representations, metrics and evaluation) with strong practical judgment on overfitting, generalization, and competing objectives.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to write high-quality production code (we work primarily in Python/PyTorch).
  • Strong data instincts: comfortable digging into raw data, questioning metrics, and validating your own results.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across disciplines.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments and take pride in producing high-quality work.
Nice to have
  • Deep expertise in a relevant subfield, e.g., time-series models (transformer-based or probabilistic/state estimation), representation learning, computer vision, or multi-sensor fusion (2D/3D perception, pose estimation, tracking, SLAM).
  • Background in wireless localization, RFID, or radar signal processing.
  • Experience optimizing and deploying ML models in mobile or resource-constrained environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based model training and inference.
  • Research experience, advanced degree, or publications in ML, vision, or systems venues.
  • Past startup experience.

Why Now

We’re a fast-moving MIT startup at an important inflection point for our product growth and direction. We are building a talent-dense team of engineers and applied researchers to solve hard, high-impact problems in retail operations.

You will have outsized ownership and autonomy. You will grow extremely quickly and make important contributions to our product, engineering culture, and company direction. We will push you to become a better engineer, and we will expect the same from you.

Technology

  • Backend: FastAPI, Python
  • Data: Postgres, Blob Storage, Parquet
  • Machine Learning: PyTorch, Ray
  • Infrastructure: Azure, Kubernetes, Helm
  • Frontend: Next.js, Typescript, Tailwind
  • Mobile: Android, Kotlin

title: Software Developer - Shared Engineering (2026)
description:
The Firm

XTX Markets is a leading algorithmic trading firm which uses state-of-the-art machine learning technology to produce price forecasts for over 53,000 financial instruments across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and crypto. It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 300 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.

We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.

XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing well over 25,000 GPUs with more than 1 exabyte of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.

At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. We are focused on teamwork and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do.


The Role

Shared Engineering is a mixed-discipline platform team of around a dozen engineers (network engineers, Linux engineers, and software developers). The team owns the foundations that the firm's engineering runs on such as alerting, job scheduling, host inventory/monitoring, and the internal developer tooling for our monorepo. This includes shared libraries, build systems and CI/CD infrastructure.

Our aim is to give the firm's engineers leverage: fewer manual steps, delivery that is fast and predictable, and teams who can self-serve rather than raising a ticket and waiting. We have many initiatives in flight at once, so judgement about which thing to work on matters nearly as much as building it well.

This is a software-developer role on the team focused on developer experience and platform software: building the tools, services, and libraries that make everyone else's engineering faster and more reliable. A growing part of that remit is how the firm's engineers adopt AI and coding-assistant tooling. Recent work includes our self-service network configuration tools, sandboxing and gateway services for coding assistants, and pulling host inventory data into a single source of truth.


Responsibilities

  • Working primarily in Go, build and own platform services and internal tooling end-to-end, from design through to production.
  • Improve developer experience by reducing friction in the build/CI/CD path, strengthen shared libraries.
  • Help shape how the wider firm adopts AI/coding-assistant tooling safely and effectively, integrating it into workflows and building guardrails and tooling around it.
  • Collaborate with the network and Linux engineers to understand what the infrastructure needs in order to scale and be managed, then expose it cleanly in software.
  • Mentor and share knowledge, improving teammates' skills and making sure others can maintain and build on the systems you develop.
  • Review and raise standards by thoughtful code review, sensible judgement on where to block versus where to let things flow, and a pragmatic sense of the right work to be doing right now.
  • Take part in on-call once up-to-speed, troubleshooting problems that span several technical domains across current and legacy infrastructure.

Essential attributes

  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals and production experience owning services end-to-end. Go is what you'd write day to day, but we care more about the fundamentals than the language: strong backgrounds in other statically typed languages are welcome.
  • Comfortable on Linux, with an understanding of the OS your software runs on (processes, networking basics, packaging, systemd), even if you're not a systems engineer.
  • Solid grasp of build systems, CI/CD, and release pipelines. You've worked in a monorepo or a serious build/release setup and made it better.
  • A track record of delivering: shipping, closing out, and not letting scope or polish stall a deliverable.
  • Good written and verbal communication, and the collaborative instinct to treat non-developer engineers as first-class colleagues.

Desirable attributes

Things we'd like to see. You won't have all of them, and that's fine.

  • Interest or hands-on experience in developer experience and AI/coding-assistant tooling. Building or integrating LLMs into a real engineering workflow is a plus, but curiosity about how these tools change work practices counts too.
  • Experience with infrastructure/platform software: inventory/asset systems, monitoring, alerting, scheduling, container orchestration or similar backend platform work.
  • APIs, data pipelines and schema management: designing clean service APIs and moving data between systems reliably.
  • Infrastructure-as-code and cloud fluency. We use Terraform and AWS as required, but experience with Azure or GCP is just as relevant.
  • Exposure to server or network hardware, networking concepts, or datacentre operations.

Senior SRE Engineer - Security

Department: Engineering

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

  • Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

  • Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About the role
As a Gorgias Platform Security Engineer, you will contribute to our security program, working directly with our SRE team and engineering leadership

You will implement and manage essential security tools and processes, with a particular focus on ensuring resilience against potential external threats and attacks.

This role will be critical in setting up proactive security measures and responding to incidents, making a tangible impact on Gorgias’ ability to meet enterprise-grade security standards.

What you will do

Platform & cloud security

  • Own cloud and Kubernetes security — IAM, RBAC, network policies, workload identity, and GKE hardening across 10+ global clusters

  • Design secure-by-default platforms — build guardrails and policy enforcement (OPA, Kyverno, or similar) that guide teams without blocking them

  • Harden CI/CD and IaC pipelines — secure GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, and Terraform workflows end-to-end

  • Lead secrets management — design and implement decoupled secrets architecture so credentials never live in deploys or repos

  • Strengthen networking fundamentals — VPC design, peering, cross-cloud connectivity, and zero-trust segmentation


    Detection & response

  • Build security-focused logging and monitoring — design the observability layer that actually catches threats, not just collects noise

  • Implement runtime detection — IDS, file integrity monitoring, and behavioral anomaly detection across GKE workloads

  • Develop incident response playbooks — practical, tested runbooks for common incident types; own the response process end-to-end

  • Manage and evolve the SIEM — drive meaningful signal-to-noise improvements and build automated mitigation where it matters


Auth & identity

  • Design and enforce strong auth standards across internal tools, APIs, and customer-facing surfaces

  • Audit and mature privileged access management — ensure least-privilege is real, not theoretical


Compliance & enterprise enablement

  • Own the ongoing health of SOC 2 Type II — keep controls tight between audits, not just before them

  • Drive the next compliance milestones — ISO 27001 and data protection (PII, GDPR) as we expand enterprise and global reach


About you:

  • 5+ years in infrastructure security, cloud security, or security engineering — ideally in a high-growth SaaS environment

  • Deep GCP and Kubernetes expertise — GKE, workload identity, network policies, RBAC; you know where the bodies are buried

  • Strong networking fundamentals — VPC design, peering, firewall architecture, zero-trust networking

  • Hands-on CI/CD and IaC hardening — GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Terraform security patterns

  • Auth expertise — OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML; you can design and audit identity flows, not just enable SSO

  • Policy-as-code experience — OPA, Kyverno, or equivalent; guardrails at the platform layer

  • Detection and response background — SIEM, IDS, runtime security tools, and experience writing real runbooks

  • Compliance experience — SOC 2 (Type II preferred), ISO 27001, GDPR/PII data protection

  • Scripting fluency — Python Go, Bash for automation, tooling, and incident response scripts


Our Stack
You’ll be working closely with our SRE team, a group of experienced engineers who are building and maintaining:

  • Multi-TB Postgres clusters

  • RabbitMQ and Redis with tens of thousands of operations per second

  • 10+ full-featured GKE clusters globally with over 15k tenants

  • A new stack of Kafka, Debezium, and Apache Flink

  • Github Actions CI and ArgoCD for scalable deployment strategies

  • Best practices around Kubernetes/Helm/Operators, SLIs/SLOs, Incident Management, Observability, Security, and Disaster Recovery

    Perks and Benefits

  • 🤕 Paid sick leave

This includes €1500 for learning material (such as books, courses, and individual coaching sessions) directly linked to your job scope, as well as a €500 wellness budget. Take advantage of these resources to grow in your role and prioritize your personal development and wellness.

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman’s Space Sector is seeking a Inspector Level 4 to join our team in Commerce, CA. This position is 100% onsite and cannot accommodate telecommute work.

This position sits at the front-line of our flight hardware quality team, ensuring that all material — from piece parts to complex propulsion tank assemblies — meets contractual, configuration, and documentation requirements. If you bring disciplined inspection execution, a systems mindset, and direct experience with an AS9100 environment, we want to hear from you.

This position works 1st shift and 9/80 schedule.

In this job, you will:

  • Perform receiving, in-process, weld, or final inspection on flight-critical hardware including piece part subassemblies and complex propulsion tank assemblies
  • Use predetermined methods, operations, setups and prescribed specifications to perform receiving, in-process, weld, or final inspection on flight-critical hardware including piece part subassemblies and complex propulsion tank assemblies
  • Use various measuring devices
  • Accept, reject, or rework defective or malfunctioning units or systems
  • Work from blueprints, diagrams, dial indicators, preset micrometers, scales, fixtures, customer specifications, drawing or inspection instructions and checklists
  • Execute inspection per applicable Quality Specification Instructions, Work Instructions, and program-specific quality requirements
  • Initiate and complete inspection records in TIPQA; verify QC Inspection Required routing in Costpoint prior to acceptance
  • Initiate Nonconformance Reports and support Material Review Board (MRB) documentation for nonconforming material
  • Apply visual, dimensional, and documentation-based inspection techniques; enforce hold conditions on material with unresolved documentation or configuration
  • Support root cause and corrective action (RCCA) reviews when escapes or systemic intake deficiencies are identified
  • Collaborate with Production teams to resolve documentation deficiencies and upstream system flags
  • Other duties as assigned

If this job description reads like it was written specifically for you, consider joining our team!

Basic Qualifications for Level 4:

  • High School diploma or equivalent and 6 years additional education and/or related experience.
  • No clearance required to start
  • Full knowledge of inspection for identity, dimensional conformance, and visual defect detection using precision measuring instruments (micrometers, gauges, calipers, optical comparators)
  • Experience with visual inspection for obvious defects or damage (corrosion, cracks, dents, scratches, pits)
  • Ability to make pass/fail acceptance decisions on inspected goods and maintain inspection records
  • Demonstrated ability to independently resolve routine inspection discrepancies and refer non-routine conditions to higher authority
  • Experience initiating and documenting Nonconformance Reports (NCRs) with factual, objective evidence
  • Working knowledge of AS9100 or equivalent QMS, with demonstrated application to weld, receiving, in-process, or final inspection
  • Ability to assist in training, orienting, or checking the work of lower-level inspectors

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficiency with TipQA inspection management system (NCR initiation)
  • Proficiency with Deltek CostPoint ERP (Purchase Order look-up, QC Inspection Required flag verification, routing)
  • Proficiency utilizing FaroArm
  • Weld inspection experience
  • AWS Certified Visual Weld Inspector or equivalent
  • CMM Programming Experience
  • Experience supporting MRB disposition activities in an AS9100 environment

description:
Senior QA Engineer (Financial Apps)

Location: Belgrade, Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Berlin, Germany; Georgia; Praha, Prague, Czech Republic; United Kingdom; Warszawa, Masovian Voivodeship, Poland

Department: R&D

The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and it trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.

About Fireblocks

Fireblocks is the institutional standard for digital asset security and settlement. We enable banks, fintechs, and exchanges—like BNY Mellon, Revolut, and ANZ—to securely navigate the blockchain economy. Our platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets.

The Mission: Quality

The Financial Apps unit builds the critical infrastructure that connects institutions to the digital asset economy. Our products cover everything from staking and yield to on-ramps, exchange integrations, and Web3 connectivity (e.g. WalletConnect).

In this role, you'll manually test all flows that need validation, and contribute to building out our automation the rest of the time. We need someone who treats quality as a holistic product challenge, takes pride in rigorous manual testing, and is eager to help grow our automation—using AI to move faster at every stage.

What You'll Do

  • Holistic Quality Ownership: You own the quality of the product end-to-end. You don't just test against a spec; you analyze the spec, find the logical gaps, and suggest improvements to ensure a better final product.
  • Hands-On Manual QA: You design and execute thorough manual test plans across complex financial and Web3 flows.
  • AI-Powered Velocity: You leverage AI agents (e.g., Claude Code) to accelerate your workflow, expand coverage, and ship faster without sacrificing depth.
  • Deep-Dive Analysis: You are comfortable digging into logs and monitoring tools (Datadog/Sentry) to understand why something broke. You aren't afraid to get your hands dirty in the backend to find the root cause.
  • Contribute to Automation: When you're not running manual flows, you help build and maintain automation across backend APIs and frontend interfaces in a fast-paced environment.
  • Product Partnership: You don't see yourself as "just a tester." You are an engineer with a product mindset who actively works to improve the systems you are checking.

Who You Are
You take real pride in finding what others miss — exploratory testing and edge-case hunting genuinely excite you, and you'd rather break something today than let a user break it tomorrow. You do both automation and manual testing, and treat both as core parts of the role.

  • 3+ years in Manual QA with hands-on automation experience across the full stack (TypeScript preferred).
  • Solid grasp of blockchain fundamentals, the transaction lifecycle, and DeFi logic like staking and bridging.
  • AI-native - you already use AI tools daily to move faster and cut through complex errors.
  • Fast learner - new domains don't slow you down; you keep pace in an industry that moves at the speed of crypto.
  • Data-driven debugger - when something breaks, logs are your first move, not your last resort.

Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms.

title: Data Architect (Contract)

Data Architect (Contract)

Melbourne (Hybrid)

$1,200-$1,300 per day

Initial 4 weeks (very likely to extend)

Short-term contract. Big architectural impact.

We're working with a Melbourne-based organisation that needs a seasoned Data Architect to come in, assess quickly, and deliver. This isn't theory or documentation-heavy - they need someone who's built and operated modern data architectures, particularly in multi-master / multi-write environments.

If you've worked across distributed systems where consistency, replication, and performance actually matter, this will be right up your street.

What you'll be doing

You'll take ownership of the current data landscape and shape what comes next.

Designing and refining scalable, resilient data architectures across cloud or hybrid environments. Leading on multi-master (multi-write) design - not just how it should work, but how it actually runs in production. Defining data models, governance, and integration strategies that hold up under pressure.

You'll be working closely with engineering, product, and business teams to make sure the architecture aligns with real-world use, not just ideal-state diagrams.

There's also a strong optimisation piece - reviewing what's there today, identifying gaps, and tightening performance, availability, and data integrity across the board.

What they're looking for
  • Proven Data Architect experience in complex environments.
  • Strong, hands-on experience designing and operating multi-master / multi-write systems (this is the key requirement).
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems - replication, conflict resolution, consistency models.
  • Experience across modern data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, streaming environments).
  • Comfortable moving quickly, making decisions, and delivering within a short engagement.
Nice to have
  • Cloud exposure (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with real-time/event-driven architectures.
  • Background in large-scale or regulated environments.
The setup
  • Hybrid role based in Melbourne.
  • Immediate start or short notice strongly preferred.
  • Initial 4-week contract with a high likelihood of extension.

If you're a Data Architect who's actually built multi-write systems - not just talked about them - this is a quick, high-impact piece of work with real scope to extend.

description:
Digital Analytics Specialist / Digital Tagging and Implementation Specialist

Location: Richmond, Melbourne VIC

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

  • Join a team at forefront of organizational data enablement and AI readiness
  • Implement and manage digital tagging across REA Group
  • 12-month fixed term contract

We're REA
With bold and ambitious goals, REA Group is changing the way the world experiences property. No matter where you're at on your property journey, we're here to help with every step - whether that's finding or financing your next home.

Our people are the key to our success. At the heart of everything we do, is a thriving culture centred around high performance and care. We are purpose driven and collaborative, which drives innovation and our ability to make a real impact. As such, we’re proud to have been named one of Australia’s Best Workplaces four times since 2021 — including third place in 2025 — plus Best Workplace for Women in 2023 and Best Workplace in Technology in 2024 and 2025. These listings are testament to every person who helps make REA a great place to work.

Where the team fits in

This role sits within the Personalisation and Privacy tribe, one of the tribes within the Consumer Group. The Consumer Group’s mandate is to be the number one destination for Australian property and real estate through the most engaging and best property experience. The Personalisation and Privacy Tribe supports and develops much of our marketing technology stack and platforms, and a privacy‑first user experience that underpins REA’s revenue, product growth and world‑class user experience. You’ll join the Tagging & Analytics team, which partners across Customer, Consumer and Ignite segments to enable self‑serve analytics and AI‑ready, composable data.

What the role is all about

As a Digital Tagging & Implementation Specialist, you will be a subject matter expert and champion of:

  • Tag Manager implementations
  • Analytics implementations, primarily Adobe Analytics (Omniture), Google Analytics and Snowplow, with others as required (e.g. Amplitude, Nielsen, Krux)
  • Defining our data layer and schema management, with a focus on composable, modular, reusable schemas

You will engage consultatively with teams across Product, Tech/Delivery and Digital/Analyst functions to guide effective collection and utilisation of audience and clickstream data. You’ll be responsible for:

  • Eliciting and documenting detailed tracking and data capture requirements; facilitating workshops with technical and non‑technical stakeholders
  • Translating REA data layer definitions into destination‑specific analytics formats
  • Implementing tagging logic and data collection via Tealium iQ (or similar TMS) and custom JavaScript
  • Debugging and resolving tagging and data quality issues across development, staging and production; validating via browser dev tools and network calls
  • Scoping and communicating downstream impacts of tracking changes on analytics, data products and ML pipelines
  • Ensuring standardized, compliant, privacy‑by‑design data capture aligned to governance and content management practices
  • Partnering with Data Science, Personalisation and Marketing to ensure tracking supports AI/ML use cases (e.g., recommendations, propensity models, marketing automation, experimentation)
  • Contributing to the evolution of REA’s event and data layer strategy toward reusable schemas shared across products and platforms
  • Identifying opportunities to automate and templatise tagging and data quality checks, including the use of AI‑assisted tools where appropriate

Who we’re looking for

  • Good practical knowledge and hands on experience of digital analytics implementations across web and app technologies and architecture Prior experience with Tealium iQ (or any TMS) and either Adobe Analytics and/or Google Analytics stacks
  • Strong fundamentals in implementation and activation (beyond reporting): events, IDs, consent, cross domain/app, attribution basics
  • Fundamental knowledge of data layers and standardized data capture practices; how schemas map to analytics endpoints
  • Knowledge of programming, system design and database concepts; strong analytical thinking
  • Demonstrated stakeholder skills: workshop facilitation, requirements elicitation and end to end guidance

Desirable

  • Intermediate or higher JavaScript and SQL and familiarity with APIs and complex JSON structures
  • Experience with Snowplow, Amplitude or similar event analytics tools
  • Familiarity with AI‑assisted tools to accelerate analytics workflows (e.g., tagging QA, anomaly detection, documentation generation)
  • Tertiary qualifications in Business, Science, Engineering or Marketing

The REA experience

The physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our people is something we’ll never stop caring about. This is a place to learn and grow.

Some of our Perks & Benefits include:

  • A hybrid and flexible approach to working
  • Flexible leave options including, birthday leave and purchase additional leave
  • Flexible parental leave offering for primary and secondary carers
  • Our Because We Care program offers employees volunteering leave, community grants, matched payroll giving and our Community Café donates 100% of revenue to charity
  • Hackdays so you can bring your big ideas to life

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We are committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity, equity and inclusion. We believe teams with diverse ideas and experiences are more creative, more eﬀective and fuel disruptive thinking. If you've got the skills, dedication and enthusiasm to learn but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

The successful candidate will own the strategic direction, technology architecture, and engineering leadership for all FX Linear Pricing platforms, spanning Spot, Forwards, NDFs, and associated hedging instruments. The role combines executive-level strategy with hands-on technical credibility. close to the teams and systems delivering it. **The role includes budget and investment responsibility.** **Strategic Leadership and Vision** + Define and own the multi-year technology strategy for of legacy infrastructure and designing next-generation, ultra low-latency, highly scalable pricing platforms + Partner with the Global Head of eFX Trading, STIRT Trading, Quant, and Risk functions to allocation is aligned to strategic priorities + Own all personnel responsibilities: performance evaluations, talent development, succession planning, hiring, and where necessary, performance We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

As an Application Developer, you’ll assist in developing, testing, and supporting the implementation of cross-functional, multi-platform application systems. Must be able to develop code and test computer programs for complex assignments related to payments. Review, analyze, and modify programming systems, including encoding, testing, and debugging. Build full-stack solutions that integrate with multiple systems, data sources, and external APIs.

Understand the business requirements and translate them into system and application design that is aligned with our technology roadmap. Hands-on 8+ years of experience integrating APIs, and event-driven systems (e.g., Solace). Experience or exposure to Docker, Kubernetes / OpenShift, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) will be an asset. Proficient with Bash, PowerShell and optionally Python.. Familiarity with mTLS, JWT, and secure API design practices. Understanding of OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Splunk, or similar monitoring and tracing frameworks. Familiarity of Git and collaborative development workflows. It is an asset if you have Experience in cloud environments (Azure). Exposure to microservice architecture and service mesh (e.g., Istio). Knowledge of financial, payments, or high-throughput transaction systems. Experience in performance tuning and capacity planning of distributed systems. Experience with OLTP applications, familiarity with the ISO20022 messaging standard will be an asset.

  • You embrace and advocate change. You'll continuously evolve your thinking and the way you work in order to deliver your best.

title: Consultant
description:
Role: Consultant (DC Design & Automation)

Location: Sydney, NSW


At TMX Transform, we help some of the world's leading organisations solve complex supply chain, property and infrastructure challenges. From automated distribution centres and logistics networks through to industrial, commercial and data centre developments, we partner with clients to design, optimise and deliver solutions that create measurable business outcomes.


Unlike many consultancies, we don't stop at recommendations. Our teams work across strategy, design and delivery, helping clients turn complex ideas into real-world outcomes.

As a growing international consultancy with teams across Australia, Asia and the UK, we're looking for talented people who enjoy solving complex problems, building strong client relationships and making a genuine impact.


Overview:

The Consultant - Supply Chain is responsible for delivering high-level supply chain consulting services to TMX clients by analysing operations, identifying improvement opportunities, and designing tailored solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and support strategic business goals. The role requires advanced analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills and contributes directly to the success of projects across various industries


Responsibilities:

  • Analyse complex operational systems, processes and workflows to identify inefficiencies, constraints, risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Apply industrial engineering principles, quantitative analysis and modelling techniques to optimise operational performance, productivity, resource utilisation and cost efficiency.
  • Design and develop improved operational processes, workflow solutions and facility configurations to enhance supply chain and logistics performance.
  • Lead distribution centre design, warehouse optimisation and operational transformation projects, including the development of facility layouts, material flow designs and operating models.
  • Conduct engineering assessments of warehouse automation technologies, including automated storage and retrieval systems (ASRS), autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), conveyors, sortation systems and other material handling solutions.
  • Develop capacity models, labour models, resource planning models and financial analyses to support engineering recommendations and operational decision-making.
  • Prepare technical reports, engineering analyses, business cases and presentations outlining improvement opportunities, proposed solutions and implementation strategies.
  • Facilitate workshops with clients and stakeholders to understand operational challenges, define requirements and translate business needs into practical engineering solutions.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including supply chain consultants, automation specialists, project managers and client stakeholders to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Apply structured problem-solving methodologies, continuous improvement techniques and data-driven analysis to improve industrial and supply chain processes.
  • Support business development and grow existing client relationships
  • Ensure all work is delivered in accordance with relevant safety, compliance, quality and professional standards.


Skills and experience:

  • Minimum 3 years’ relevant experience in industrial engineering, intralogistics, warehouse automation.
  • Experience designing, optimising or delivering distribution centre solutions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (preferably Industrial Engineering).
  • Strong understanding of warehouse operations, automation and material handling systems.
  • Experience developing business cases and supporting capital investment decisions.
  • Strong analytical, modelling and problem-solving capability.
  • Ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Proven project delivery and client management experience.
  • Experience with AutoCAD, SketchUp or similar design tools preferred.
  • Knowledge of WMS platforms and warehouse technologies.

title: Data Transport Portfolio Architect
description:
Data Transport Portfolio Architect

Location: Chantilly, VA

WE ARE THE NRO
For sixty years, the NRO has developed, acquired, launched and operated the satellites that are the foundation for America’s advantage and strength in space. Using a diversified architecture of spacecraft, NRO collects and delivers the best space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance content on the planet.

Learn more at NRO.gov.

Basic Eligibility For A Position With The NRO
  • You must be a U.S. Citizen
  • You must be able to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance
  • You will be subject to pre-employment and periodic drug testing
  • You will be subject to pre-employment and periodic polygraph examinations

Where You Will Work
The Office of Chief Architect (OCA) is in search of a sharp, critically thinking problem solver to serve as an Enterprise Architect in the Data Transport enterprise capability portfolio area. This position is non-supervisory however the individual will lead a team of 2-3 contractors. OCA advances the NRO Enterprise by defining, assessing, and delivering the future NRO Enterprise Architecture, shaping investment decisions, and enabling enterprise decision-making. It does so by formulating strategic architecture imperatives for the NRO, developing end-to-end architecture capability at all layers of the Enterprise (space, ground, application, data, facility, infrastructure, etc.), executing long-term strategic planning, driving NRO architecture investments to advance the mission and address strategic challenges. OCA represents the NRO on IC and DoD major architecture initiatives and significant shared programs and advises NRO senior leadership on NRO Enterprise advancement to ensure NRO maintains strategic advantage in today’s rapidly changing national security environment.

The NRO Cadre is collecting resumes for consideration against current and future opportunities for senior level (GG-13), Enterprise Architects, occupational series 0801. For more information on the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) occupational series, click here.

Your resume may be considered for other positions which your skills and experience may be a good match.

This is a full-time position that is open from 7 August, 2026 through 21 August, 2026. Resumes must be submitted by 11:59 PM EST on 21 August, 2026.

Who May Apply
  • This position is open to the public.
  • Federal government employees MUST currently be at the grade level or higher as indicated in this announcement. This is NOT a promotion opportunity for current Federal government employees. If selected for the position, Federal government employees will transition laterally at their current grade level and step.
  • Federal applicants who exceed the advertised grade may voluntarily request acceptance at the lower grade per IAW DoWI 1400.25 Volume 2006.
  • The NRO is only accepting external applicants for this job announcement. Current NRO Cadre employees should apply internally.
  • This position may not qualify for the appointment of a reemployed federal annuitant IAW DoWI 1400.25 Volume 300.

What You Will Be Doing
Enterprise Architects in OCA help advance the NRO enterprise in delivering capability by conducting and overseeing technical analyses and assessments to support senior-level decision making, maturing architecture concepts and strategies as necessary, and developing planning guidance to drive investment and assess budget execution. They explore and experiment with new and/or improved concepts, technology, and strategies and work to determine feasibility, enterprise utility, and risk. Enterprise Architects will execute often ambiguous tasks requiring new enterprise approaches, sophisticated architectural techniques, creative collection solutions, and utilizes enterprise digital engineering models.
As an NRO Enterprise Data Transport Architect you will:
  • Define end-to-end data flow architectures from collection to delivery
  • Create layered architecture models (physical, data link, network, application)
  • Develop requirements for future architectures aligning to user needs and strategic intent
  • Define interfaces between space, ground, and tactical edge segments
  • Design redundant path architectures to eliminate single points of failure
  • Develop architectures that accommodate future growth
  • Conduct architecture reviews with stakeholders
  • Validate designs against mission requirements and technology options

What You Need
Required
  • Bachelor's degree in Professional Engineering or related field
  • Sound understanding of intelligence satellite systems
  • Expertise in multidisciplinary engineering concepts, principles, and practices
  • Proven critical thinking and analytical writing skills
  • Demonstrated project management and leadership abilities
Desired
  • Knowledge of DoD and Intelligence Community (IC) organizations, missions, relevant policies, and processes
  • Understanding of government acquisition processes
  • Knowledge of and ability to apply analytic, diagnostic, and qualitative techniques sufficient to produce authoritative analytical products, and the ability to employ new methodological approaches to analyze information
  • Experience with commercial, civil, national security, or defense space missions
  • Familiarity with digital engineering environments

Qualifying experience may have been acquired in any public or private sector job, but will clearly demonstrate past experience in the application of the particular competencies/knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to successfully perform and is typically in or directly related to the duties of the position as described above. Experience must be reflected in your resume.

Applicants submitting a resume that exceeds the two-page limit per OPM Memorandum, “Merit Hiring Plan,” dated May 29, 2025, https://www.opm.gov/chcoc/latest-memos/merit-hiring-plan.pdf will not be eligible for consideration. For more information regarding resume writing, see “Guidance for Applicants on 2-Page Resume” and visit the Resume Help Center.

Other Information
  • Overtime Statement: MAY be required to work other than normal duty hours, which may include evenings, weekends, and/or holidays.
  • Travel Statement: MAY be required to travel in military or commercial aircraft to perform temporary duty assignments.
  • Financial Disclosure: MAY be required to file an OGE Form 450, Confidential Financial Disclosure Report, upon appointment and will be required to file annually.
  • Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) coded positions: If selected for a DAWIA coded position, the incumbent must meet appropriate certification requirements IAW the Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) no later than 24 months after accepting this position. Individual shall maintain, at a minimum 80 continuous Learning Points every 24 months via the services acquisition management system. DAWIA requirements may be located at the Defense Acquisition University website.
  • Geographic Mobility Agreement: MAY be subject to directed reassignment as required to address mission effectiveness, and/or career development.
  • Information Assurance (IA): Must achieve the appropriate IA certification within six months of assignment.
  • Emergency Essential: Certain positions MAY be deemed emergency essential and incumbents must be willing to meet all position requirements.

Location
Chantilly, VA 20151
Telework is not available and you must be able to work at the specified location(s).

Salary
This position meets the qualifications for Defense Civilian Intelligence Personnel System (DCIPS) Targeted Local Market Supplement (TLMS) STEM pay for NRO Cadre employees and candidates as authorized by the office of the Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security’s (OUSD(I&S)). Cadre employees and candidates are eligible to receive STEM pay if they are currently serving in a STEM designated position. Should a Cadre employee or candidate earning STEM pay change positions within the organization, they must be assigned to another STEM qualifying position in order to continue to remain eligible for STEM pay. Otherwise, Cadre employees and Candidates Generally would be transitioned to the DCIPS GG Pay Scale. For more information on STEM pay, visit https://dcips.defense.gov/Human-Resources/Compensation/

2026 salary range for the Washington, DC area: GG-13 $132,751 – $181,428

To qualify for the position, federal government employees MUST currently be at the GG – 13 grade level and may ONLY apply for a lateral reassignment at their current grade level and step. Federal applicants who exceed the advertised grade may voluntarily request acceptance at the lower grade per IAW DoWI 1400.25 Volume 2006.

Veterans’ Preference
